📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that the noise started in a corner of the South Stand, early in the second half. It was muffled at first, but as the ball popped from one white shirt to another, it became louder and louder, sweeping around the stadium: here was the soundtrack for a humiliation.

“Olé! Olé! Olé!” they roared and why not? Leeds were ripping Newcastle to pieces, knocking passes around them as if they were training-ground mannequins. Football has become a sport that leaves people increasingly vexed, but this was a night when – for the locals, at least – it was almost a throwback.

There was energy and ferocious tackling, a No 9 soaring like centre-forwards used to in the not-too-distant past and lots of goals as Leeds cut loose and abruptly ended whatever honeymoon Matthias Jaissle had been experiencing in charge of Newcastle.

According to recent reports, “I suppose in football you can always find something to moan about,” Daniel Farke, the Leeds manager, mentioned. “But this was a top-class performance.”.

In a recent development, it has felt suspiciously like Newcastle’s start has been like an overstuffed plastic shopping bag, the handles straining to the point of snapping. Eventually they fell asunder. Leeds ran all over them and were too smart, slick and hungry, not to mention ruthless. No wonder Jaissle had nowhere to go.

Industry observers note that the home fans were adamant this was one of the best nights Leeds have experienced under Farke and if they were prepared to say as much, you had an obligation to listen. Forget how wretched Newcastle were, Leeds had produced a performance to enable imaginations to run wild.

Centre to it all was Ao Tanaka, with his desire to keep Leeds playing forward, but it felt wrong to talk about one man when you had the unstoppable Dominic Calvert-Lewin, who would be substituted to a standing ovation, and the ubiquitous James Justin, among others.

According to recent reports, "He just cannot stop scoring at Elland Road" 🔥Dominic Calvert-Lewin makes it 2-0 to Leeds! pic.twitter.com/Pv1TEpc5Qj.

The foundations are being put in around the stadium for a cavernous fresh West Stand, and Farke’s remit is to ensure that Leeds will be firmly established in the Premier League by the time it is completed in the summer of 2028.

To be fair to Farke, he has laid a sturdy base for this team to thrive and it felt before kick-off that this was going to be a big evening for Leeds, who had made a quietly encouraging start to the campaign and had negotiated three challenging away trips without defeat.

Sources indicate that big? It turned out to be spectacular. The first half was so one-sided that a boxing referee would not have allowed Newcastle to come out for the second, such was the pummelling they received; wave after wave of white-shirted raids left the visitors black and blue.

Aside from one little rick inside the opening 10 minutes, when James Trafford dithered and presented Yoane Wissa with a chance to mug him, Leeds were every bit as sensational as Newcastle were shocking, seizing on the opportunity to go on a rampage.

Recent findings suggest that leeds would have been in front after 11 minutes but Ethan Ampadu’s fierce drive battered into Calvert-Lewin’s legs and bounced away. Normally in such circumstances, players will wave an arm to berate their bad luck, but Ampadu, celebrating his 26th birthday, smiled: he, like everyone else, sensed what was coming.

Jayden Bogle, Justin and Nico Elvedi all had opportunities to open the scoring earlier, but eventually, they found the weak spot. Newcastle, who had lost the influential Nico González to a potential concussion, had replaced him with Sean Steur and what an influence he would have on matters.

On the half hour, Steur was a fraction too late getting out to close down Tanaka, whose shot ricocheted off him and to Lewis Miley, before looping away from Lukas Hornicek and dropping into the corner of the net in dam-busting fashion.

Ao Tanaka's deflected effort puts Leeds ahead! ⚪ pic.twitter.com/cYXVi3LOAO.

Recent findings suggest that leeds were running even quicker by this point, pressing as if their lives depended on it and making tackles that were lustily acclaimed in the stands. Steur completely short-circuited in the bedlam and a ridiculous pass on the edge of his area was pounced upon by Bogle.

Out went a ball to Justin, whose cross was whipped into the penalty area, where Calvert-Lewin had climbed to get his head to it, though replays indicated his effort glanced off Bogle’s head – determining the true scorer will make for an interesting conversation.

Calvert-Lewin, at least, got the reward his efforts deserved on the cusp of half-time, spinning away from Miley and chopping inside Sven Botman before delivering the kind of finish that should make Thomas Tuchel take note when selecting his next England squad this week.

"They are relentless!"Dominic Calvert-Lewin caps off a dominant first-half from Leeds 💪 pic.twitter.com/S6kQykOMW9.

The gloss, after those “olés”, was applied in the 59th minute when Noah Okafor put a realistic hue on the score, ramming in a finish in front of the Kop and leaving Newcastle open to the crudest mocking for the amount of money they have spent to resemble such a disorganised rabble.

A wonderful strike with equally brilliant celebrations from Noah Okafor! 🕺 pic.twitter.com/Ce1ueKtH4x.

Bazoumana Touré, at least, scored a consolation goal, but Jaissle barely flickered as it went in and the emotion belonged to Farke, who thundered on to the pitch at the final whistle and sought out his captain, Ampadu, who had erred in allowing Newcastle’s substitute to profit.

“That was an unnecessary goal to concede and I so wanted us to keep a clean sheet,” Farke sighed. “We deserved a clean sheet and I couldn’t help myself. I had to tell him because I am sometimes a perfectionist. We must try to stay humble, but we can be an outstanding team.”.

And this, for certain, was an outstanding night.

[It was brutal out there?] That’s football. That’s the Premier League. It was clear from the start and I have said it many times. We will have ups and downs and challenges all the way. Tonight we faced that challenge. It’s tough and difficult to digest. But there is a chance to learn out of that and there’s a long time until our next match at home and that is good.

Sources indicate that it’s clear with our young squad that there will be ups and downs and you have to bring the fundamentals on the pitch against such a physical team. Leeds are so intense, we couldn’t match that physicality. There are other aspects of course but I don’t want to make excuses. We want to learn out of it and be better.

[Were you overwhelmed as a team?] No. If you don’t bring that physicality on the pitch, you struggle.

Industry observers note that exactly this [message to the players]. Bring your fundamentals and we build on it. [Can you bounce back from this in your next game?] Of course. [Is your confidence hit?] No.

In a recent development, for each manager it would be a nightmare after such a game to concede so late and not have the well-deserved clean sheet. Of course I was not happy about the situation. Doesn’t take anything away from my boys who were magnificent. Terrific start with eight points but there’s never a perfect performance. There’s always something to moan about. At very rare points [in the season] I have to criticise [for conceding].

Sources indicate that energy, quality, good structure, in an out of possession, which is complicated against Newcastle, In pressing them you always have to be aware of their unbelievable pace and strength in counter-attacks. We found this balance today and in the first half particularly we were dominant.

It has been revealed that we have a good fitness level now. Need to find the right triggers to press. It’s a lot of well-structured work on the training ground. We had more chances to score tonight but overall I am very happy with our performance.

[Calvert-Lewin being praised] It is well deserved. He is in outstanding shape and plays with lots of confidence. I expect him to lead the group with some other players. His work-rate is never in doubt and to me he is one of the best strikers in the league.

The ref told me at half-time that they’ve taken it off me. I didn’t know he [Bogle] was there to be fair. I just got up and went ‘Bang!’ It is what it is. I’ll take the assist!

I didn’t know anything about it [being given credit for the second goal]. I noted to the ref, I don’t fancy telling him [Calvert-Lewin]. To be fair he’s still raging. He’s raging with the goal but happy with the result.

Industry observers note that it’s about having an understanding with the players around you. With Dom up there, you know he’s going to win everything so you have to get the runners around him.

It’s about the rotation like today. When James Justin goes wider there’s space inside. Dom occupies two centre-backs so there’s always pockets.

According to recent reports, regardless of the scoreline it was a tough game physically. They’re a very good side. We take it game by game, not to get carried away. Everyone’s ambitious in their own way but we have to take it game by game.

A proper stuffing for Newcastle as Leeds continue to impress and climb up to third.

There will be a lot of excitement surrounding Mathias Fernandez-Pardo’s first start for Newcastle United following his deadline day move from Lille but also keep an eye on Jacob Murphy on the right wing.

Fernandez-Pardo starts with a clean slate at Newcastle, Murphy has a lot of baggage and he has been a popular online target for criticism over the last year or so.

Indeed, some sections of the fanbase were stunned Newcastle rejected a £15m offer from Nottingham Forest on deadline day for a player who has entered the final 12 months of his contract.

Murphy has his limitations, sure and he can be infuriating sometimes when he gives the ball away cheaply, but there is a reason Matthias Jaissle was adamant he could not be sold.

Part of that is due to the fact he does not have another specialist right winger behind Anthony Elanga who misses the Leeds game through injury.

But Murphy is also valued for his experience and his training ground presence. He has been at the club a long time, working under Rafa Benítez, Steve Bruce and Eddie Howe and is a boyhood Newcastle fan.

Jaissle was not willing to lose that from his dressing room. Ultimately, though, Murphy has to perform on the pitch to justify the faith shown in him.

Recent findings suggest that there are not many other options to fill that position while Elanga is missing. Harvey Barnes does not like playing on the right, Amar Dedic is a full back and so is Tino Livramento.

According to recent reports, this is an opportunity for Murphy to silence his detractors and prove the faith Jaissle has put in him is not misplaced. At the age of 31, he knows he is not the most popular or appreciated player at the club but he has never shirked or complained about that.

According to recent reports, he formed a potent partnership with Alexander Isak when he was leading the line for Newcastle. Can he do the same with the new boy Fernandez-Pardo?

Mind you I remember his visit to Elland Road in 1982-83. Not for the faint hearted. In fact it was a disgrace when he was hit by a coin. And yet he was always gracious about Leeds and particularly fond of Don Revie. He was one of very few football people without a strong Leeds United connection who went to his funeral in 1989.

Apparently he was injured in training, the nature of the injury is unspecified.

After many years of suffering our supporters deserve it [high expectations]. It’s good but we are far away from not being humble. Our feet are on the ground. We know the second year is always difficult. We have made a good start and it is always crucial to ride the momentum as long as possible.

Sources indicate that eddie Howe has left a legacy and the culture he created is still around. Matthias has to work with it. They are unbeaten. they are very dangerous with many pacy players up front. It’s crucial not to lose the ball too easily and always be switched on against Newcastle.

Recent findings suggest that good evening and welcome to live coverage of Leeds United vs Newcastle United, the last Premier League match of the fourth round of fixtures for the 2026-27 season. Both clubs have made unbeaten starts with one win and two draws each and a win today for wither would send them up to fourth. The two sides met at Elland Road in the third match of last season which ended in a 0-0 draw but the return fixture at St James’ Park was one of the games of the season, a ding-dong match that Leeds led 0-1, 1-2 and 2-3, the latter until the 91st minute and yet still lost 4-3.

The architect of that victory for Newcastle was the Leeds’ fans’ incubus, a player commonly known around Elland Road as ‘Harvey F------- Barnes’. His two goals that night were his sixth and seventh against Leeds in eight matches for Leicester and the Toon. Back in the last century and at the turn of this one, Alan Shearer scored 21 league goals in 23 games against Leeds for Blackburn Rovers and Newcastle, it can feel like one bogeyman passing the baton to another.

Sources indicate that newcastle’s sound form with their new model team this season has been based on searing pace and their ability on the counter whether with runners, in the case of Anthony Elanga, or with long diagonals against Tottenham that ripped a hole in the left side of their defence. Leeds rallied from being overrun by Brentford at half-time in their last home game to switch from three at the back to four and wrest back the initiative and while they reverted for the Brighton draw, in both games it was the introduction of Ao Tanaka in midfield that gave them control.

It is genuinely hard to decide whether the 6-3 defeat by Chelsea in the Carabao Cup from being 2-0 up at Stamford Bridge is significant to Leeds league form. One simplistic way of looking at it would be to say Leeds reserves were better than Chelsea’s reserves in the first half and Chelsea’s first-team were better than Leeds reserves and their shaky, debutant keeper in the second. But any similar defensive frailties tonight and there will be jitters over the next week before the international break. Newcastle, by contrast, toiled in their 1-0 victory over Millwall but the result glosses over a lack of incision for long spells of it.

Recent findings suggest that joe Rodon is out for Leeds for at least another month while Newcastle have changed to withholding information about their treatment room under Matthias Jaissle who states that it should be ‘confidential’. 📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Gattuso lo inserisce all’88’: è il ritorno in campionato dopo l’amichevole contro il Mgarr United.

According to recent reports, il ritorno in campionato, poi una rete cancellata dal fuorigioco. Albert Gudmundsson ritrova il campo in Serie A nella vittoria della Lazio contro il Lecce e nel recupero arriva anche a superare Falcone. Un’azione che avrebbe completato il suo pomeriggio all’Olimpico, ma che non modifica il risultato: finisce 3-0, con la doppietta di Noslin e il pallonetto di Frattesi. Per l’islandese resta il ritorno a disposizione di Gennaro Gattuso anche in una partita ufficiale. Dopo il percorso di recupero e il passaggio nell’amichevole durante la sosta, contro i salentini arriva uno spezzone nel finale.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Gattuso manda in campo Gudmundsson all’88’ al posto di Andrea Pinamonti, con la Lazio avanti di due reti.

According to recent reports, poco dopo Frattesi firma il terzo gol, mettendo definitivamente al sicuro il successo biancoceleste. Il minuto della sostituzione è confermato dal tabellino ufficiale della società. Nel recupero l’islandese trova lo spazio alle spalle della difesa, evita Falcone e deposita il pallone in rete. La partenza in posizione di fuorigioco rende però vano il suo tentativo. Prima del Lecce, Gudmundsson aveva già ritrovato minuti nell’amichevole del 14 novembre contro il Mgarr United.

Retroscena da San Siro: clamoroso Amorim, preghiera a Modric, Cardinale sogna,

Prima di raccontarvi cosa è successo nella pancia di San Siro al termine del match, quando ormai tutti i calciatori erano praticamente usciti dallo spogliatoio, bisogna ripercorrere le dichiarazioni dei due frontman mediatici più importanti del mondo Milan: Gerry Cardinale, il proprietario del club, e Ruben Amorim, l'allenatore.

Lasciando lo stadio, Cardinale ha risposto ad una domanda sulle possibilità Scudetto del Milan con tanta tanta fiducia: "Siamo a novembre. Abbiamo ancora molta strada da fare. Ma in ogni partita vogliamo vedere dei miglioramenti. Questo weekend è stato molto interessante se guardi il tipo di risultati che ci sono stati. Si può vedere che qualcosa sta cambiando in Serie A. Sono stato molto contento di vederci non solo vincere, ma vincere con quel margine. E, quindi, dobbiamo costruirci sopra, ma come dice Amorim, ogni partita è qualcosa su cui costruire e abbiamo molta strada da fare. Io personalmente mi aspetto ancora che competiamo per lo scudetto, ma è lontano. Una partita alla volta. Ora l'attenzione è sull'Europa League. Sì, e come ha detto Ruben dobbiamo fare entrambe le cose. Le competizioni europee sono importanti. Tutto è un banco di prova. Se vuoi vincere uno scudetto, devi farlo fino in fondo, ed è quello che faremo".

Amorim, invece, in conferenza stampa si è presentato senza sorridere troppo: strano dopo un 5-1. Ma era successo anche dopo il derby. E ha parlato criticando - nel complesso - le prestazioni dei suoi, contestualizzando quella di ieri: strano dopo un 5-1. Ma era successo anche dopo il derby: "Ieri a partita non è stata solo una questione tattica. Si sono visti cambi di posizione, uno contro uno con tantissimo spazio: sembrava una gara pazza. Quello che ho percepito contro il Genoa e nelle altre partite è che eravamo troppo lontani, non arrivavamo nell'ultimo terzo di campo. Non siamo come le significant: se guardate le grandi squadre, per esempio la Juventus, magari fatica nei risultati, ma vedete il volume che produce. Per noi è un po' l'opposto, quindi sono davvero preoccupato che, se non miglioriamo, non potremo mantenere questo numero di punti. Oggi però è stato un passo avanti: si sono visti tanti giocatori attaccare la profondità, cosa che non si era vista contro il Ferencvaros. Nelle altre gare avevamo gestito bene il pallone, ma oggi servivano ritmo e corse. Dobbiamo riuscire a giocare entrambe le partite all'interno della stessa gara, ma oggi era chiaramente il tipo di partita che dovevamo fare per vincere". La sua non è stata assolutamente una risposta al proprietario, ma una constatazione oggettiva del percorso che sta facendo il Milan. I calciatori, dal canto loro, parlano apertamente di Scudetto: lo ha fatto Cisse ieri, lo hanno fatto altri compagni nel recente passato. Ma la linea resta una: c'è da migliorare molto, tanto, anche grazie a ciò che accadrà nel mercato di gennaio.

C'è un calciatore, tra gli altri, che sta facendo molto bene in questa stagione: Luka Modric. Non una sorpresa, si direbbe. Ma a 41 anni nulla è scontato. Lasciando lo stadio, i tifosi che lo attendevano gli hanno chiesto di rimanere un altro anno in rossonero. Se il croato continua così, non può fare altrimenti.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

There is an obligation on all of us, from supporters to pundits and journalists, to remain calm and measured about footballers as young as Max Dowman. But, my word, he does make it difficult. Arsenal’s 16-year-old sensation continues to sparkle whenever he steps on to the field, and he did so again with this superb display against Ipswich Town.

"The hype will only continue to grow!"Max Dowman that is delightful! 👏 pic.twitter.com/UfFY1VSyXn.

In a recent development, at this rate, Arsenal supporters will be looking forward to Carabao Cup matches as eagerly as any Premier League or Champions League game, simply because it will be a chance to watch Dowman again. The forward’s age and inexperience means he is still used sparingly in those high-priority competitions. The League Cup, by contrast, may prove to be his domain over the coming months.

It has been revealed that dowman’s double at Portman Road made him just the second 16-year-old to score two goals in a game for a Premier League side. The first was Wayne Rooney, for Everton against Wrexham in 2002.

Recent findings suggest that the two goals underlined why there is so much excitement around Dowman. The first was a demonstration of his prodigious dribbling ability, as he weaved through Ipswich’s defence and buried his shot with the weaker right foot. The second demonstrated his composure: a slotted finish, rolled in with ease.

Max Dowman nets his second of the game! 😍 pic.twitter.com/XRZ9GqZx3x.

It has been revealed that as Mikel Arteta approaches the point of signing a new contract in north London, one wonders how much the idea of developing Dowman will excite him as he looks to the future. Which manager would not want to coach a player of such natural ability? Which manager would not want to see how good he could be? The same is true of Marli Salmon, the 17-year-old defender who also impressed on Tuesday night.

According to recent reports, “A joy to have him,” said Arteta of Dowman. “It’s remarkable. It’s something very natural for him. He can deliver those actions effortlessly, I would say. What we have to do is look after him. He is 16. You don’t see that in this league. In other leagues in Europe, that’s a totally different context.

In a recent development, “Having two teenagers playing for Arsenal at this level is so fulfilling. Because I’ve been there and just to be able to contribute to somebody’s career and dream, to be able to experience a game like tonight, is phenomenal. And yeah, medium and long term, we know that if they continue to develop in the way that they are, we are going to have two tremendous footballers.”.

"He was brilliant, he made the difference - we need to look after him" 🌟Mikel Arteta claims Arsenal need to "be really cautious" with 16-year-old Max Dowman after he scored twice in Arsenal's 4-2 win over Ipswich 🔴 pic.twitter.com/1msJAEkK8z.

Sources indicate that dowman’s two goals, along with strikes by Noni Madueke and Mikel Merino, secured a comfortable victory for Arsenal against Premier League opponents. Ipswich scored a goal of their own, through Anis Mehmeti, but never seemed likely to cause the visitors too much bother. A late strike from former Arsenal player Chuba Akpom was only a consolation. “We found a way to fight back into it,” mentioned Gary O’Neil. “Losing by two goals to them isn’t a dreadful effort.”.

Dowman is already developing a trademark goal, of sorts. His first strike for the club, against Everton last season, came after he left an opponent face-down on the turf at the Emirates Stadium. He inflicted the same pain here upon poor Cédric Kipré, who tried to tackle the teenager in the seventh minute but ended up with a mouthful of grass.

It was an image that encapsulated Arsenal’s dominance in the early exchanges, as was the sight of Madueke firing in the second. The chance came after Bruno Guimarães and Merino, majestic in midfield, had monstered Ipswich’s attempts to play out from the back. Merino was dominant throughout, winning tackles with steel and then spinning away opponents with style. “He’s unbelievable,” noted Arteta.

Arsenal’s long-term relationship with the League Cup is not a particularly healthy one. For a club of their stature, it is a source of mild embarrassment that they have not won this competition since 1993. They came close last season, reaching the final at Wembley, but were defeated by Manchester City.

In a recent development, given the depth of Arteta’s squad, Arsenal really should reach the final again. If this is a tournament for the B-team, at least in these early stages, then Arsenal probably have the best B-team in the country. They started this game without any of Bukayo Saka, Declan Rice, Martin Odegaard, and Kai Havertz but were still extraordinarily strong in midfield and attack.

It has been revealed that the only pre-match concern was their defence, which has been weakened by a couple of early-season injuries. Arsenal started with Salmon at centre-back and the teenager was in direct combat with the physical, sharp-elbowed threat of Ipswich striker Zian Flemming. He stood up to the challenge with determination and class.

In a recent development, ipswich had made 10 changes following their victory at Crystal Palace at the weekend, which was an indication of where the Carabao Cup sits in their priorities. They were able to get into Arsenal’s penalty area but never gave the impression they could really hurt the Premier League champions, apart from when Mehmeti converted Jack Clarke’s low cross.

It has been revealed that akpom struck in the 91st minute to encourage O’Neil, but by then the game had been lost. Arsenal’s work, and indeed Dowman’s work, had been done.

"He's 16 years old, and we have to be cautious of that" 💫Mikel Arteta reacts to an incredible performance from Max Dowman as Arsenal put FOUR past Ipswich 🔴Don't miss the Carabao Cup on @paramountplus 📺 pic.twitter.com/AIcAbMx6ub.

Industry observers note that on managing the hype that surrounds Dowman, Arteta mentioned: “What we have to do is look after him. He’s 16 years old, you don’t see that in this league. In other leagues in Europe, that’s a totally different context, but in this league, with the demands... We need to make sure that every time we throw him in it’s in the right context with the right preparation.”.

Conor Coady shares his thoughts on Arteta’s role in Dowman’s development:.

"He'll know how to nurture him!" 🗣️Conor Coady indicates Mikel Arteta is the perfect manager for Max Dowman 👏 pic.twitter.com/YdgLxfKiOf.

Asked about Dowman’s two-goal performance, Arteta said: “A joy to have him, Marli [Salmon] as well. Seventeen years old, to play at that level with the physicality they have to be able to handle that level, it’s remarkable. Max, yeah, it’s inevitable to talk about him when he scores and he creates the moments he has created tonight. It’s normal.”.

He added: “He is coping better and better and better, he did the action where he regains the ball and wins it in the first goal, he loses his man... He’s an unbelievable player because of the character that he has and how much he loves to play on the biggest stage and still handles the situation with such naturality.”.

Speaking in his post-match press conference, Mikel Arteta said: “Really pleased with a lot of things we did tonight, the way we attacked the game, how dominant, fluid and aggressive we were, right from the beginning to try to influence the result. We scored two very early goals that gave us obviously a great platform for the game.

“Individually some big performances as well. Some debuts tonight which is great to see as well, so we take a lot of positives from tonight.”.

Arsenal have won the League Cup twice – in 1987 and 1993 – meaning eight clubs have better records, including Aston Villa (five titles), Tottenham Hotspur (four), Nottingham Forest (four) and Leicester City (three).

In a recent development, their rather modest haul is a far cry from their record-setting 14 FA Cup titles. In the 33-years since Arsenal’s most recent League Cup triumph, the competition’s title sponsor has changed hands four times (kudos to anyone who can name all five!).

No team has scored more goals through substitutes in the Premier League than Ipswich, which is a nod to the promoted club’s depth and work in the summer transfer window.

Sources indicate that it has meant that Gary O’Neil has had to leave established players out of match-day squads. “It was really tough leaving out Darnell [Furlong] and Anis [Mehmeti] from the squad [against Crystal Palace],” he said. “Doing that to good people is one of the toughest parts of the job. But I have faith in them, it’s just that everyone’s fit at the moment and we’ve had to recruit a strong squad to get us through an unbelievably challenging season.

“On Tuesday, whoever I pick, I have 100 per cent faith that they’re ready and that they’re going to represent what we do and how we go about it.”.

On Hincapie’s omission from the match-day squad:.

“Some players were carrying some fatigue, some little problems that we have to look after and some other players are available, fresh and in better conditions to play.

On Timber being left out of tonight’s squad:.

Industry observers note that “Everything is fine, but obviously he has played much more than we would have wanted. He played 53 minutes [against Sunderland] after five months. I will need to look after him.”.

When asked if Arsenal will set up with a back three tonight:.

Alan Davies, the actor and comedian who is a famously passionate supporter of Arsenal, recently told a story about a charity event he once attended with former captain Tony Adams. Speaking on The Tuesday Club podcast, Davies stated Adams revealed his football philosophy to be: “You need seven.”.

Recent findings suggest that the “seven” in question, Adams explained, are seven members of the team who are ready and willing to fight the opposition in the tunnel after the game. Once a team have those seven individuals, Adams remarked, everything else flows from there.

Recent findings suggest that for much of the past two decades, Arsenal have not had seven. In some years in the latter stages of Arsène Wenger’s tenure, they probably did not even have three or four. But that has all changed in recent seasons under Mikel Arteta, to such an extent that the Premier League champions would now undoubtedly bring considerably more than seven combatants to any touchline scrap or tunnel bust-up.

Saturday’s gritty 2-0 victory away to Sunderland provided evidence that Arsenal have added two more of these characters to their squad this summer.

Recent findings suggest that tonight will be a good test for young Marli Salmon, the 17-year-old defender who is the latest high-class graduate of the Arsenal academy. Arsenal have extremely high hopes for Salmon, who made four senior appearances last season. He could be in the centre of defence or at right-back tonight. I suspect Ipswich striker Zian Flemming might try to target Salmon with some physical challenges, especially in the air. Let’s see how he handles it.

Max Dowman unveiled himself last season, showing off his gilded footwork in impressive cameos off the bench. Who could forget that lung-busting run and goal against Everton?

Industry observers note that and while the 16-year-old winger featured in Arsenal’s pre-season, these will be his first minutes of senior football in the season proper. His only game time thus far has come in the Premier League 2 under-21s competition and he was not included in the match-day squad at the Stadium of Light on Saturday.

When asked about Dowman after the victory at Sunderland, Arteta said: “I wish we could have him here, but we have the limitation with the numbers that we can have. He will have his chance, he will have his minutes and he will have to earn them like anybody else. We know the talent that we have, we know the players that we have there and we need to help him and find a way to make sure he continues to develop and help the team.”.

Although keeping Ipswich in the Premier League must be Gary O’Neil’s primary goal, he has insisted that the club will embrace opportunities in the cups.

Recent findings suggest that when asked how he would approach tonight’s tie, O’Neil said: “We’ll have a strong side, we’ve worked our socks off in the transfer window to give ourselves a strong squad. Of course, a different level to Arsenal, but we’ll be strong on Tuesday and we’ll do our best to win the game.

“The club has worked so hard to have these moments and of course it’s a cup game, but to have Arsenal and Liverpool come to Portman Road a week or so apart is what everyone has worked so hard for in recent years, so we’re going to enjoy it, we’re going to have a right go and worst thing that can happen is we lose to Arsenal.”.

Good evening from Portman Road, where it’s a gorgeous night for football. Ipswich have made 10 changes, which is an indication of where this competition sits in their list of priorities. Arsenal have made nine.

Good evening and welcome to our live coverage of the Carabao Cup third-round tie between Ipswich Town and Arsenal. Mikel Arteta’s side have won all six of their matches so far this season, but travel to Portman Road fresh off an incident-filled win over Sunderland which thrust officiating back into the spotlight after Ezri Konsa conceded a penalty having been – in Arteta’s words – “judo-rolled” by Dan Ballard.

After the match, the Arsenal manager said: “I watched [the incident] 20 times and I cannot find a way to understand how to even think to give a penalty in this situation or the way the VAR has to intervene. So I don’t know what to think, really. But I’m sad, that we have to discuss, after such a beautiful game, something at this level that has the gravity of that because that changes the course of the season and it can cost you the championship… This cannot happen.”.

Arteta may be pleased that VAR is not in use at this stage of the Carabao Cup, and all eyes will be on Peter Bankes who takes charge of tonight’s match against Ipswich.

Recent findings suggest that this season Arsenal hope to arrest a startling League Cup record. It has been 33 years since they last lifted the trophy, during which time they have been runners-up seven times. Losing last year’s final will have also added fuel to Arsenal’s fire, and Arteta may resolve he must field a strong starting XI. In fact, he may not have much choice in his backline as Ben White has emerged as a serious injury doubt after picking up an injury at the Stadium of Light and may join Cristhian Mosquera and William Saliba on the treatment table. This would likely mean starting Jurriën Timber, who is only just returning from a long-term groin issue. There is more scope for rotation in advanced positions, with Noni Madueke, Viktor Gyokeres, Eberechi Eze and Mikel Merino contenders to start.

A 90th-minute Zian Flemming winner against Crystal Palace on Saturday helped Gary O’Neil’s Ipswich to their second win in four Premier League games, a feat they required 16 matches to achieve the last time they were in the top flight. Heavy investment into Ipswich’s squad has proved fruitful thus far, though in-form striker Emersonn is expected to sit out tonight having taken a knock at Selhurst Park.

La Commissione esaminerà i dati al 30 settembre; a Formello si teme uno stop, ma resta la possibilità di intervenire sui conti.

Sources indicate that la Lazio attende l’esame dei conti al 30 settembre per sapere come potrà operare nel mercato di gennaio: liberamente, a saldo zero o con un blocco. Secondo quanto riportato da Calciomercato.it, A Formello prevale un leggero pessimismo e il club si aspetta lo stop, che potrebbe però essere superato con le misure previste dall’articolo 90 delle Noif.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

La Commissione che ha sostituito la Covisoc valuterà la documentazione presentata dalla società. Se la Lazio avrà raggiunto il parametro dello 0,70%, potrà muoversi liberamente. Se la situazione sarà peggiorata rispetto a marzo, il mercato sarà bloccato; negli altri casi, il club opererà a saldo zero.

It has been revealed that la Lazio arriva da una sessione estiva a saldo zero. Al 31 marzo il rapporto tra costi e ricavi aveva superato la soglia dello 0,70%, raggiungendo lo 0,82%, con un disavanzo di circa 20 milioni di euro e un conseguente blocco parziale.

Industry observers note that nel recente bilancio, il costo del personale è salito da 98,2 a 104,6 milioni di euro e gli ammortamenti dei calciatori da 32,7 a 38,4 milioni. Il monte ingaggi è invece sceso da 79,5 a circa 75 milioni. Il club ha inoltre inserito a bilancio 7 milioni legati a Polymarket, limitati alla quota del primo anno dell’accordo quinquennale di sponsorizzazione, bloccato dall’autorità.

According to recent reports, incideranno anche gli incassi del botteghino e i mancati introiti europei. La scorsa stagione la Lazio aveva messo a bilancio circa 20 milioni dagli ingressi allo stadio; in quella attuale, lo sciopero del tifo ha bloccato questa entrata. In caso di stop al mercato, la società potrebbe pagare una sanzione e coprire l’eventuale deficit per rientrare nei parametri. Lotito sta cercando di sistemare il passivo inserendo crediti o dilazionando alcuni pagamenti, in particolare quelli relativi al periodo Covid.

Industry observers note that cristian Chivu, tecnico dell'Inter, ha analizzato ai microfoni di DAZN il pareggio di stasera per 4-4 sul campo dell'Atalanta: "Ho detto nel primo tempo che ci stavamo facendo del male da soli e che giocavamo col fuoco? Abbiamo avuto tre doppi vantaggi, il rammarico è questo: si aveva la sensazione di doveva fare quello che non si è fatto, che si poteva un po' gestire le cose. Quando abbiamo avuto il pepe siamo riusciti sempre ad andare in doppio vantaggio: abbiamo fallito la prova di maturità nei minuti finale quando non siamo riusciti a mantenere il vantaggio creato. Complimenti all'Atalanta perché ha annusato superficialità e leggerezza e hanno provato fino in fondo mettendoci in difficoltà coi cross e riempiendo l'area. Noi più leggeri del solito e alla fine la paghi: ci dispiace, sono due punti regalati. Impariamo la lezione e si va avanti, cercheremo di mantenere il livello alto nelle prossime.

Il problema in difesa? Bisogna capire le situazioni di gioco: il secondo gol dell'Atalanta nasce da un angolo dopo una grande occasione loro nello stesso modo e nello stesso punto. Poi siamo andati 4-2 e poi è arrivato un po' di casino, una palla in verticale a difesa schierata tutti sotto palla: è sempre una questione che dobbiamo lavorare sulla grinta e sull'atteggiamento. I cambi? Sulle corsie soffrivamo troppo, un po' per leggerezza e non andavamo a duello lasciando spazio a loro per mettere cross: abbiamo cercato di rimediare visto che le mezzali non andavano più al raddoppio. Col 4-3 ho deciso di mettere Thuram a dare una mano a Spence, ma per me è sempre una questione di voglia di fare duelli e non subire, di non fidarsi di quello che accade perché il minimo errore lo paghi se non hai la stessa voglia nei duelli.

According to recent reports, se sono più arrabbiato per il pareggio o preoccupato per i gol concessi? I gol concessi sono troppi, per una squadra che ha alte ambizioni: dobbiamo rimediare come a Rotterdam e col Como. Io non guardo indietro ma dobbiamo imparare tutti che bisogna mettercela tutta in campo e mai pensare di gestire le energie dando il massimo finché l'arbitro non fischia".

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that nella fredda serata di San Siro il Milan travolge il Frosinone 5-1 e conferma il momento positivo che sta vivendo in campionato, dove è reduce da cinque vittorie nelle ultime sei partite. La formazione di Ruben Amorim ha si da subito messo la partita sui binari giusto, costruendo il successo attraverso ripartenze rapidissime, capaci di mandare continuamente in tilt l'assetto ultra offensivo degli uomini di Massimliano Alvini. Protagonisti assoluti Rabiot, Moreira e Pulisic, con Modric, Gonçalo Ramos, Cisse e Jashari a completare una serata quasi perfetta.

According to recent reports, il Frosinone ha provato a giocare senza paura, schierandosi con una linea molto alta e un 3-4-3 senza un vero centravanti, così da non dare punti di riferimento alla formazione di Ruben Amorim. Una scelta coraggiosa che si trasforma in un problema, considerata la velocità di un Milan che più cinico di così non poteva essere.

Il vantaggio nasce sull'asse Rabiot-Modric, con Calvani che anticipa Pulisic deviando la palla nella propria porta. Poco dopo Moreira conclude un'altra ripartenza offrendo al solito Rabiot che dentro l'area di rigore trova un indisturbato Gonçalo Ramos che torna alla rete 35 giorni dopo l'ultima volta. Nel mentre Masini sfrutta un'indecisione di De Winter per accorciare le distante, ma nella ripresa Amorim sistema la squadra che dilaga.

I giochi vengono chiusi nella ripresa quando il Milan prima si porta avanti di due gol con Jashari, poi di tre con Cisse ed infine con il quarto, ma quinto complessivo, di Christian Pulisic. Rabiot chiude la partita da protagonista assoluto con tre assist (uno ha causato l'autogol), arrivando a sette complessivi in stagione, mentre Moreira ha dominato in lungo e largo sulla fascia destra. Straordinaria anche la prestazione di Modric, che a 41 anni continua a stupire.

Il Milan consolida così il quarto posto e continua la propria rincorsa in campionato, dove il ritmo anche delle altre è impressionante. Ora l'attenzione si sposta sull'Europa League e sulla trasferta greca di Atene contro l'Olympiacos, dove i rossoneri avranno l'obbligo di correggere l proprio cammino continentale fino a questo moment molto complicato.

3′ – Chirico perde il possesso della palla, Kone parte in contropiede verso l’area di rigore, uscita di Mataluna che è bravo a respingere il suo tiro.

14:30 – Inizia la ripresa, batte la Lazio.

39′ – Occasione Napoli allo scadere: cross dalla sinistra, sul secondo palo arriva Maglio in corsa, ma era molto defilato, il suo pallonetto finisce alto.

22′ – Occasione per il Napoli: cross basso dalla destra, e dopo un rimpallo, Ciotola calcia di prima intenzione, il suo tiro finisce alto.

17′ – Ammonito il tecnico della Lazio Gualdaroni per proteste.

Industry observers note that 16′ – Doppia occasione per la Lazio: cross dalla destra, Spoletini colpisce di testa, ma respinge Mataluna. Sulla ribattuta ancora Spoletini ci prova, ma Mataluna mette in corner.

4′ – Contropiede del Napoli: Tambaro porta via il pallone centralmente, poi scarica a Ciotola in area, che calcia a botta sicura, la Lazio salva sulla linea.

3′ – Ripartenza dal basso sbagliata della Lazio, Maglio recupera palla dal limite ma calcia sul fondo.

13:35 – Inizia il match, batte il Napoli.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Dal ritiro con il Vejle all’offerta biancoceleste: il dirigente ripercorre il lavoro svolto con il difensore danese.

Sources indicate that mario Nicolae ripercorre il percorso di Oliver Provstgaard, dal Vejle alla Lazio, e ritiene che il difensore potrebbe fare bene anche all’Inter, club al quale viene accostato. Secondo quanto riportato da TuttoMercatoWeb, Il dirigente, che oggi lavora al Rapid Bucarest, racconta la fiducia data al danese quando era un giovane dell’accademia e le tappe che lo hanno portato al trasferimento in biancoceleste.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

In a recent development, nicolae aveva già definito Provstgaard «un vero gioiello pronto al grande salto». Ora ricorda il progetto costruito attorno a lui, l’offerta della Lazio e il ruolo avuto dai suoi agenti nell’operazione.

Nicolae incontrò Provstgaard al Vejle, in Danimarca. Il dirigente ripercorre i suoi primi mesi nel club e la preparazione del ritiro: «Quando sono arrivato la squadra era ultima in classifica in Danimarca, a dicembre. Ci stavamo organizzando per il ritiro ad Antalya in Turchia, stavamo facendo la rosa di chi sarebbe venuto con noi. Ero nuovo, ho sentito tante opinioni tra proprietà e staff sui giocatori interessanti, quelli con cui proseguire. Mi hanno accennato di Oliver che in quel momento era giovane, veniva dall'accademia ma arrivava dai problemi ai crociati e non giocava da mesi».

In a recent development, nonostante l’infortunio e i mesi senza giocare, le qualità del difensore convinsero Nicolae a portarlo in Turchia: «Però era giovane, di prospettiva, fisicamente molto interessante e intelligente. Mi è sembrato giusto portarlo subito in ritiro con noi. Ho iniziato a conoscerlo e ho rinnovato subito il suo contratto!».

According to recent reports, la scelta di coinvolgerlo nel ritiro fu dunque il primo passo di un percorso che, secondo Nicolae, richiedeva fiducia e lavoro condiviso. Il dirigente aveva ascoltato le valutazioni interne prima di puntare sul giovane centrale.

Il successivo cambio di allenatore diede continuità al progetto sul difensore. Nicolae racconta: «A marzo abbiamo cambiato allenatore, abbiamo preso un tecnico croato molto giovane come Ivan Prelec, che aveva esperienza nell'accademia della Dinamo Zagabria e quindi coi ragazzi. Gli ho accennato il progetto Provstgaard, lì siamo retrocessi ma Oliver ha esordito tra i pro in Serie A. Il secondo anno siamo tornati subito su, vincendo la Serie B danese con lui titolarissimo».

According to recent reports, nicolae sottolinea che non si trattò soltanto di credere nelle qualità del giocatore. «Non ho solo avuto fiducia e visione su Provstgaard ma c'è stato anche un progetto con lui, con allenatore e proprietà, abbiamo detto che era un prospetto della società con cui c'era da lavorare per creare un prodotto per una grande lega europea. Gli abbiamo dato fiducia anche quando, e capitava poche volte, non giocava bene», spiega.

It has been revealed that al lavoro del club si aggiunse quello di Oliver. Nicolae ne ripercorre i progressi, dall’Under 21 e dalla fascia di capitano della selezione giovanile fino al posto da titolare nella massima serie danese. Ricorda anche la cessione, avvenuta nella settimana in cui il Vejle fu venduto, e la propria successiva partenza: «Ha lavorato come un pazzo: è arrivato in Under 21, poi è stato capitano dell'Under, in Serie A poi ha giocato chiaramente da titolare. Poi siamo riusciti a venderlo alla Lazio proprio nella settimana in cui il club è stato poi venduto e poi sono andato via anche io… La Lazio ha fatto la miglior offerta, c'era il Pisa con un'offerta ufficiale e anche altri club. Tramite i suoi agenti, che avevano già Isaksen alla Lazio, è stata un'operazione importante e chiaramente questo è stato un fattore». La Lazio presentò l’offerta migliore; il Pisa ne aveva formulata una ufficiale e c’erano anche altre società interessate.

Nel percorso al Vejle fu importante anche Raul Albentosa, capitano spagnolo della squadra. Nicolae collega l’ambizione di Provstgaard al sostegno ricevuto dal compagno: «Ha sempre voluto crescere, ha sempre voluto arrivare in un top club nel Mondo. Al Vejle abbiamo fatto grandi cose insieme, è stata l'esperienza perfetta per lui. E' cresciuto al fianco del nostro capitano spagnolo, Raul Albentosa, che è stato un fratello per lui. Oltre 100 presenze in Liga e lo ha guidato passo dopo passo in questo progetto di due anni e mezzo».

In a recent development, per Nicolae, Midtjylland e Copenhagen avrebbero rappresentato un salto importante ma interno al calcio danese. Riteneva invece Provstgaard pronto per una grande squadra anche fuori dalla Danimarca: «Era già pronto per andare in un top club. Poteva andare al Midtjylland, al Copenhagen, ma sarebbe stato solo un salto di livello interno anche se molto importante. Dal Vejle alla Lazio è stato il grande salto, chiaramente, ma sì, era già pronto. L'Italia ha sempre apprezzato i giocatori scandinavi, non è un caso che ci abbiano pensato. Per me vederlo in prima pagina su un grande quotidiano è un grande orgoglio».

L’Udinese mette un primo mattoncino positivo nella gestione Paolo Zanetti, mettendo a referto un’ottima prova corale contro il Bologna e dando la sensazione di essere ancora squadra viva dopo diverse prestazioni completamente a vuoto. Sembra essere quindi riuscito a toccare le corde giuste il tecnico durante questa sosta per le nazionali e nei giorni in cui ha potuto lavorare con il gruppo al completo. Ne nasce così un 1-1 che smuove la classifica dei bianconeri fino a un certo punto, ma i friulani portano a casa soprattutto una prestazione che può ridare un po’ di slancio tra le difficoltà.

Sources indicate that il tecnico deve rinunciare a Davis, che ha avuto un nuovo infortunio muscolare e non si sa quando potrà rientrare. Con anche Gueye fuori (almeno fino a gennaio), le scelte per il ruolo di numero 9 diventano così poche ed è una problematica con cui l’Udinese dovrà convivere per un po’. Zanetti decide quindi di optare per Zaniolo falso nove, con il ritorno di Lovric a centrocampo, lasciando così in panchina Chakvetadze e Unai Gomez, che fino ad ora hanno convinto poco.

E’ stata quindi anche la gara delle scelte importanti da parte dell’allenatore, che sulla fascia destra decide di schierare Abankwah per contenere Cambiaghi, lasciando in panchina Vojvoda, che ha mostrato di non avere abbastanza gamba per contenere avversari rapidi. In difesa quindi al centro va Kabasele, con Palma a destra e Solet a sinistra. L’Udinese convince dal punto di vista dell’atteggiamento e con le novità volute da Zanetti inizialmente disorienta anche il Bologna, rendendosi pericolosa. I felsinei riescono nel finale ad alzare un po’ i giri del motore, trovando il gol con Zortea sull’unica azione pericolosa della prima frazione.

La buona notizia arriva dall’approccio anche avuto dai friulani nella ripresa, restano sul pezzo e trovano il pareggio con Zaniolo, che si lascia andare nei festeggiamenti abbracciando Zanetti dopo il problema personale avuto nei giorni scorsi e che lo ha costretto a lasciare il ritiro della nazionale con largo anticipo. Nel finale qualche folata da entrambe le squadre, con la coppia Ekkelenkamp-Bayo che avrebbe anche una chance importante per trovare un colpaccio, finisce in pareggio e per i segnali dati va bene così, ora per l’Udinese ci sarà il compito più difficile, ovvero riconfermarsi nel tempo per risalire la china.

In a recent development, in zona mista al termine di Atalanta-Inter 4-4, l’attaccante nerazzurro Pio Esposito ha parlato così della rimonta subita. “Sicuramente faccio fatica a godermi la tripletta perché non è servita a portare la vittoria a casa che è sempre la cosa più importante.

Non parlerei di reparti, si parla di squadra, siamo l’Inter, forse ci siamo un po’ adagiati quando siamo andati in vantaggio e l’hanno poi riaperta. Da domani si analizza quanto fatto di buono e quanto no e si cerca di migliorare come sempre.

Partita buttata via? Passo indietro mi sembra eccessivo, vero che l’abbiamo buttata via, non deve succedere, ma allo stesso tempo non si è perso. Passo indietro mi sembra esagerato. Ci sono da limare dei dettagli, non devono riaprire la gara due volte, ma da domani si guarda avanti.

Difesa non così forte nei numeri? Non mi soffermerei sui reparti, quando si fa la fase difensiva la facciamo 11, meriti e demeriti sempre tutti insieme, ci sarà da migliorare perché è oggettivo e lo dobbiamo fare tutti insieme”.

Il dato sostiene quindi la lettura di un centrocampista coinvolto nel collegamento con l’attacco, capace di contribuire alla continuità della manovra avanzata.

Frosinone midfielder Giacomo Calò has fired a warning to AC Milan ahead of Sunday’s game, insisting they do not feel any pressure.

Industry observers note that in many ways, Frosinone have been the surprise package of Serie A so far this season. Having been promoted from Serie B in 2025-26, they have racked up six wins in 11 games, scoring 24 goals in the process and allowing 15.

Read SempreMilan ad-free and get access to exclusive news. Click here for a free trial!

Recent findings suggest that they are 13 points above the relegation zone, which is very impressive given that the mission before a ball was kicked will likely have been just to get above the dotted line by any means. Now, they face a trip to San Siro where they can really test how far they have come.

Milan may be four points ahead, but Frosinone will come to try and cause a bit of a stir. Giacomo Calò gave an interview to Il Messaggero (via MilanPress) in which he discussed the upcoming games for the Lazio-based side.

What are Frosinone’s aims for the season?

“At first it was to stay up. Then we’ll see during the year, because we’ve only played eleven games and there are still a lot to go. We know it’s a tough league, that we could have some very difficult moments, with the schedule that Milan, Inter, Roma, and Lazio now have in store for us.

5 – Il #Frosinone è la squadra che conta più giocatori che hanno preso parte ad almeno 5 gol in questa stagione nei Big-5 campionati europei, ben 5:.

Comitiva.#FrosinoneTorino pic.twitter.com/DYlhg1mdVB.

— OptaPaolo (@OptaPaolo) November 1, 2026.

“This start is helping us today and maybe it will be useful in a few months. We’ll take it game by game, without any pressure.”.

What do you like about the head coach Alvini?

Sources indicate that “His tremendous enthusiasm and how he prepares for the game. On the pitch, you always know what you have to do, where your team-mates are, where you need to go. We never arrive at a game with any doubts. In the game, we find everything he says during the week.”.

Milan are expected to welcome back Strahinja Pavlovic for the game, while encouraging news also arrived regarding Mike Maignan’s condition on Tuesday too.

#72796. Spurs finally score... but still lose

📅 16 Sep 2026 • ⏱️ 25m • 📚 Deep Dive (5011 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Co ↗ Open Full Page

Spurs finally score... but still lose

📅 16 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 25 min read (5011 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~25 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Recent findings suggest that they scored.
  • According to recent reports, it could have been something different.
  • Sources indicate that “I think this is five or six games we have been for sure not lucky,” De Zerbi lamented, but sympathy did not extend too far.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that they scored. Would you believe it? Tottenham Hotspur, the team with more zeroes than an England Ashes batting collapse, found the back of the net but still frustration persists for Roberto De Zerbi.

According to recent reports, it could have been something different. The sight of the Italian dashing down the touchline in hailstones, grabbing his head in disbelief in the final seconds, indicated this was not a straightforward tale of misery but, ultimately, the misery endures.

Sources indicate that “I think this is five or six games we have been for sure not lucky,” De Zerbi lamented, but sympathy did not extend too far. Liverpool deservedly moved into the next round of the Carabao Cup, the gloss on Andoni Iraola’s most enjoyable night provided by Dominik Szoboszlai’s goal-of-the-season contender.

THAT'S MAGNIFICENT! 💥🔴Outrageous strike from Dominik Szoboszlai 👏👏👏 pic.twitter.com/meQ7nilsz6.

Liverpool were abject against Fulham on Saturday but with 10 changes to the starting line-up, infused with the exuberance of novices Rio Ngumoha and the terrific Lewis Koumas, Iraola’s team were invigorated and only a lapse of concentration enabled Tottenham to make a fist of it.

In a recent development, yes, they went down swinging, as their noisy fans demanded. But carelessness cannot be excused and while De Zerbi complained about bad luck, a bad miss from Lucas Bergvall in the 10th minute was the fork in the road for the tie. Tottenham stalled and Liverpool never looked back.

According to recent reports, “We have to shoot more times and we have to shoot better,” De Zerbi harrumphed. “We have to finish better the clear situations. We are sorry for the result, disappointed and frustrated. I think it was unfair but we have to be stronger in these unlucky moments.”.

Sources indicate that rather than fizzing his drive into the net, Bergvall succeeded only in firing straight at Giorgi Mamardashvili, when he had the whole target in front of him. It was, in all fairness, a brilliant save but he should never have been allowed to make it.

Sources indicate that major save from Giorgi Mamardashvili! 💪Lucas Bergvall is denied by the Liverpool goalkeeper. pic.twitter.com/fKUbfGLMku.

In a recent development, the miss changed the atmosphere, as suddenly Liverpool grasped the need to be competitive. At the heart of it all were Ngumoha, James McConnell, Trey Nyoni and Koumas, the last-named a nuisance to Tottenham’s defenders in the way a wasp is to picnickers on a summer’s afternoon.

In a recent development, for all the money that has been lavished by this club over the past 14 months, the one thing that the locals buy into more than anything is the basics done properly: hard work, tackling, a refusal to take second best. Iraola did not want Koumas to go anywhere this summer and it was obvious why.

Industry observers note that “I see him training every day,” Iraola stated. “He knows very clearly what he needs to do, what the team needs. And also the energy he shows is contagious for the rest. When you see the runs up front, giving everything, you are kind of forced to go behind and use the same intensity levels.”.

Simple tenacity enabled Liverpool to get back on an even keel and laid the foundation for them to take the lead. It was a terrific goal, started with a raking pass from Joe Gomez that Cody Gakpo controlled instantly on his chest before scuttling inside and inviting Ngumoha to charge forward.

Whether it was the winger or Destiny Udogie, who was sliding to make a challenge, that ended up playing the ball to Alexis Mac Allister is immaterial, all that mattered is that the Argentine effortlessly placed his shot into the top corner, leaving Martin Dubravka planted and helpless.

Pick that out!! 🇦🇷Alexis Mac Allister hits a beauty into the roof of the net 🔴 pic.twitter.com/G7OT27CA8P.

Is Mac Allister playing with a point to prove? Possibly, given his comments about not being offered a fresh contract last week. Will Iraola be bothered? Not in the slightest. All he wants is top players at the top of their game and Mac Allister is climbing towards the levels he showed two years ago.

What De Zerbi would do to have a player in such form, but Tottenham are a skittish bunch, not the type of team who respond well in the face of adversity and their head coach, dressed in black with his oversized white trainers, regularly shook his head in exasperation.

His mood was not helped just before the interval, when Mohammed Kudus blasted over from eight yards following a zipped-in cross from Udogie, but he would not have called it truthfully if he had suggested Tottenham deserved parity at that stage. Soon Liverpool’s advantage would be doubled.

The buffer they sought arrived in the 54th minute and, again, it was another genuinely attractive goal, with possession being kept until it sped up when Ngumoha scurried forward, found Milos Kerkez, who played it to Mac Allister, who in turn gave Gakpo the opening he craved.

His touch was excellent, his finish was even better and away in the distance Iraola rattled his fists in delight. That is two goals and four assists to start the campaign for the Dutchman and yet Liverpool were ready to sell him to Manchester City two weeks ago. What on earth were they thinking?

Ruthless!! 🔥Cody Gakpo doubles Liverpool's lead against Spurs 🔴 pic.twitter.com/qlaaynMuwM.

Recent findings suggest that from that point, it seemed inconceivable that Liverpool would finish living on their nerves, but De Zerbi’s decision to introduce Andy Robertson – given a hero’s reception on his first return to Anfield – and Mateus Fernandes wrestled back some impetus. There was also a significant helping hand.

Unsurprisingly, Andy Robertson gets a great reception from the Liverpool fans on his return to Anfield 👏 pic.twitter.com/uNM6A00k5F.

Mamardashvili had made some vital saves, including one from Kudus that he celebrated on his own, but he is vulnerable at set-pieces and Fernandes’s looping corner gave Conor Gallagher the easiest headed opportunity in three years to change the dynamic.

Sources indicate that spurs have scored! ⚪️Conor Gallagher brings Roberto De Zerbi's side back into the game! pic.twitter.com/52zSCqClw4.

“We were under pressure at the end, but I don’t think we were nervous,” Gakpo said.

He was right. Try as they might, Spurs could not quite get the opening they needed and as they chased in vain, Szoboszlai administered the final blow in mesmerising fashion, thrashing a bouncing ball into the Kop net from 30 yards. And as De Zerbi realised in the sodden conditions, with Tottenham it never rains. It only pours.

"A Steven Gerrard type of strike" 😍Jamie Redknapp and Conor Coady analyse Dominik Szoboszlai's wondergoal 🪄 pic.twitter.com/h9QTuP8lZc.

🗣️ "The young players give us energy" 💪Andoni Iraola is very pleased with the way the Liverpool youngsters played after beating Spurs 3-1 at Anfield 👏#ITVFootball | @Carabao_Cup | @markpougatch | @Robbie9Fowler pic.twitter.com/bHjOrmccH2.

🗣️"Szoboszlai scores A LOT OF BANGERS"😂Needless to say Cody Gakpo was really impressed with Dominik Szoboszlai's goal for Liverpool 👏#ITVFootball | @LFC | @Carabao_Cup | @gabrielclarke05 pic.twitter.com/O3bs6Y9M2p.

"They've done themselves proud!" 👏Conor Coady on Lewis Koumas performance for Liverpool 🔥 pic.twitter.com/3JGkuY7Eye.

A place in the League Cup fourth round is at stake at Anfield as Liverpool host Tottenham in an all-Premier League tie.

Liverpool were frustrated on the weekend, being held to a 0-0 draw at home against Fulham, meaning they have one win and three draws from their opening four league games.

Sources indicate that “I am very happy with the squad,” Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola mentioned. “I value a lot my players, if we win games, the squad will look amazing and fantastic, if we do not there is going to be a problem with the depth. I think we will see also tomorrow [tonight] players we have not seen still and I am really looking forward to seeing. I feel they are going to play well and help us and they still have not had their chance. You can decide and put the same players in every game. The problem is there will be a moment when they are really tired. And there is more risk of injury.

“But that is why we cannot say it does not work for anyone. There are players who play every three days with no concerns. They are very robust, their performances do not change too much. There are other players where the risk is bigger and the performances are different. I have to learn who is ready to play games every three days and who needs a rest so their performance level is not affected. I thought I had it quite clear in my mind with some, but with others, it is newly introduced, even for them, because they have not played as many games. We are learning.”.

According to recent reports, liverpool were knocked out in the fourth round of this competition last season, losing 3-0 at home against Crystal Palace. Joe Gomez returns to the squad for the hosts tonight after an injury early in pre-season but Giovanni Leoni, Hugo Ekitike, Conor Bradley and Federico Chiesa remain out.

Tottenham are still without a league win or goal this season. Their 0-0 draw at home against Everton Saturday means they sit just above the relegation zone. Tottenham overcame Charlton in the second round, convincingly winning 5-1 at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium last month.

It has been revealed that “I think we are working well,” Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi said. “We played 30 minutes, 25 minutes very well [against Everton]. In that moment we could score two goals. Then we lost maybe the confidence because we did not score. For sure we have to improve. For sure I have significant confidence in my players, they are very good players.

Industry observers note that “We have to improve, yes. We can say the coach has responsibility if we do not score, yes, I accept, no problem. We did not win any game so far, yes. We are disappointed, sorry for that. But we have other positive things, like I remarked we did not [concede goals] in the last two games and the things we have to improve, we start our work. Nothing changed in my project and my idea.”.

According to recent reports, tottenham’s League Cup journey last season came to an end in the fourth round last season, losing 2-0 at Newcastle. Sandro Tonali and Pedro Porro will not be involved tonight for the visitors and neither will Richarlison, who has been left out. Andrew Robertson returns to Anfield for the first time after leaving Liverpool in the summer following nine years on Merseyside.

Team news from Anfield to follow shortly.

AC Milan and Juventus are both keeping tabs on Benjamin Sesko’s situation at Manchester United, according to a report.

Sources indicate that united paid around €80m to sign Sesko from RB Leipzig, hoping he would be the long-term fix for the No.9 position. Last season he performed reasonably well, scoring 11 goals in 30 Premier League games which was not bad for a 22-year-old in a latest league.

This season, however, he is stuck on one goal in four league games, having spent time out injured too. With big changes at Old Trafford – including the arrival of Mauricio Pochettino as the head coach – it is another blank slate for the squad.

It has been revealed that for example, club captain Bruno Fernandes has been linked with a move to Milan. Now, according to journalist Alessandro Jacobone, a upcoming idea has emerged for the centre-forward position, perhaps if the pursuit of Nicolo Tresoldi does not go to plan.

“Juve and Milan are keeping an eye on things. But summer is the most realistic scenario. Benjamin Šeško could leave Manchester United, with Juventus and Milan having already made some preliminary enquiries to assess the financial feasibility of a potential move,” he noted.

Recent findings suggest that “For now, these are only preliminary discussions, useful for finding out the figures, conditions and possible deal structures. No concrete negotiations have been initiated.

Sources indicate that “Sources close to the player’s camp are also playing down the possibility of a transfer as early as January, making a potential move in the next summer window considerably more likely. One to watch.”.

In a recent development, four of those 11 goals in his debut campaign came off the bench too as he developed a knack for being an impact substitute. This could give Milan food for thought, given they are looking for an alter-ego to Goncalo Ramos rather than someone to solely take over the striker role.

Questa volta sono i nerazzurri a farsi rimontare, incapaci di proteggere un vantaggio che per ben tre volte sembrava poter mettere la parola fine alla partita. Finisce 4-4 contro l'Atalanta, al termine di una serata che lascia parecchi interrogativi, soprattutto per quanto riguarda la tenuta difensiva. Eppure, l'inizio aveva raccontato una storia completamente diversa. L'Inter parte forte, cerca subito la porta avversaria e trova il vantaggio con Pio Esposito, bravo a sfruttare l'assist di Barella dopo una manovra sviluppata rapidamente. Il giovane attaccante si ripete poco dopo, questa volta di testa, sul calcio d'angolo di Dimarco, approfittando di una marcatura praticamente inesistente. La squadra di Chivu sembra avere il controllo della gara, anche se l'Atalanta prova ad affacciarsi dalle parti di Martinez, costretto a un grande intervento sulla conclusione di De Ketelaere. Nel frattempo arriva anche la prima tegola. Calhanoglu deve lasciare il campo per un problema muscolare al flessore e al suo posto entra Sucic. Prima dell'intervallo, Elmas approfitta di un'altra disattenzione della retroguardia interista e riporta i padroni di casa in partita. Un gol che avrebbe dovuto rappresentare un campanello d'allarme e che invece non sembra trovare una risposta adeguata.

Sources indicate that nella ripresa l'Inter riparte con la stessa voglia di allungare e trova nuovamente la strada del gol. Ancora Pio Esposito, ancora una volta protagonista, servito da un Thuram che inventa un pallone perfetto per tempi e precisione. Il numero 94 completa la tripletta e firma una prestazione che rappresenta una delle notizie più belle per Chivu. Tre reti diverse, tre situazioni in cui dimostra di saper leggere il gioco e di farsi trovare pronto quando la squadra ne ha bisogno. Anche il dialogo con Thuram offre indicazioni interessanti. I due sembrano capirsi e trovare con naturalezza gli spazi per collaborare. Ma mentre Esposito continua a fare il suo, l'Inter torna a complicarsi la vita. Sul calcio d'angolo battuto da Zalewski, De Ketelaere trova ancora una volta troppo spazio e accorcia le distanze, con Akanji che perde completamente il riferimento. La partita si riapre, ma i nerazzurri hanno ancora la possibilità di ristabilire le distanze: Zappacosta intercetta con il braccio sulla linea la conclusione di Thuram e Sucic trasforma il calcio di rigore del 4-2. Sembra il momento giusto per mettere ordine e gestire il risultato, invece l'Atalanta continua a trovare spazi. Chivu concede minuti anche a Curtis Jones e ritrova Lautaro Martinez, nuovamente in campo dopo l'assenza iniziata con la sfida contro il Bruges del 13 ottobre. Ma neppure i cambi riescono a cambiare l'andamento della gara. De Ketelaere firma la sua doppietta con una conclusione deviata dalla schiena di Pavard dopo il passaggio di Rowe dalla linea di fondo. Il 4-3 restituisce fiducia ai bergamaschi e mette nuovamente a nudo le difficoltà dell'Inter.

Il pareggio arriva al 91', quando il tocco di braccio di Bastoni nel contrasto con De Ketelaere porta al calcio di rigore trasformato da Kessié. È l'ultimo atto di una rimonta che l'Inter avrebbe dovuto evitare, soprattutto considerando quante volte nel corso della stagione era riuscita a fare esattamente il contrario. La squadra che aveva costruito una parte dei propri risultati sulla capacità di reagire agli svantaggi si ritrova adesso a dover spiegare come sia stato possibile lasciarsi sfuggire una partita nella quale aveva segnato quattro gol e avuto per due volte un vantaggio di due reti. Il problema non riguarda soltanto i singoli episodi. Le disattenzioni si ripetono, le marcature saltano e gli avversari riescono a trovare con troppa facilità la strada verso la porta. È un aspetto sul quale Chivu dovrà necessariamente lavorare, perché una squadra con le ambizioni dell'Inter non può permettersi di concedere così tanto. In mezzo a una serata complicata resta però la prestazione di Pio Esposito, che merita un discorso a parte. La tripletta non è soltanto un bel numero da aggiungere al tabellino, ma la conferma di una crescita che sta diventando sempre più evidente. Il ragazzo si fa trovare pronto, sfrutta le occasioni e dimostra di poter essere una risorsa importante anche quando il livello della partita si alza. Per lui è una serata da ricordare, per l'Inter una partita da analizzare con attenzione. Perché se davanti Pio continua a dare segnali così incoraggianti, dietro c'è una squadra che deve ritrovare al più presto le proprie certezze. Questa volta la rimonta l'hanno subita i nerazzurri di Milano. E il pareggio di Bergamo deve servire da avvertimento.

Il mercato si avvicina e per il Napoli a breve sarà il momento della verità su tante situazioni. C’è l’esigenza di fare qualcosa di importante soprattutto in due reparti per rendere la squadra più competitiva per provare a tornare il più velocemente possibile in zona Europa.

Sources indicate that A centrocampo sono previste le novità principali visto che De Bruyne e Anguissa potrebbero partire. Per il belga il Psv farà di tutto per cercare di averlo già in questa sessione. Per il secondo sullo sfondo resta l’ipotesi di un ritorno a Marsiglia ma attenzione anche all’Inter a giugno se il giocatore alla fine decidesse di rimanere fino al termine della stagione in azzurro. Insomma con questa situazione fluida il ds Manna sta sondando diversi terreni per trovare la soluzione più giusta per Allegri. L’ultima idea arriva dalla Premier League. Il nome è quello di Mateo Kovacic, classe 1994, in scadenza di contratto con il City il 30 giugno 2027. Il club inglese potrebbe lasciarlo partire anche a gennaio magari a condizioni vantaggiose. Il problema vero non è tanto la trattativa con il City, quanto l’ingaggio molto alto del croato. Ovviamente questa resta un’opzione ma i riflettori sono decisamente più accesi in casa Monaco dove i profili che piacciono molto sono Coulibaly e Camara.

Recent findings suggest that anche In attacco si preannunciano novità. Lucca, Lang e Neres potrebbero andare via. L’ex Benfica in Brasile ha mercato. Per Lang c’è il Galatasaray. Se ci dovesse essere la partenza di uno di questi ultimi due, diventerebbe necessario prendere almeno un esterno. In Premier League i profili sono Gittens, Dorgu e Quenda. Da decifrare ancora il futuro di Lucca, che dovrebbe uscire in prestito. Il Napoli per sostituirlo aveva pensato in primis a Varela. Sul bomber del Monza pero è aumentata la concorrenza con Tottenham, Brighton e United sulle sue tracce. Sebastiano Esposito piace molto ma il Sassuolo non ha intenzione di cederlo a gennaio.

According to recent reports, last month, just before Milan’s resounding 3-1 derby win over Inter at San Siro, the two clubs unveiled the Generali Stadium. The vision is that it will become the new home for the two sides within four years, replacing San Siro which recently turned 100 years old.

According to recent reports, it is not just about having a new stadium for the sake of it, but rather to improve the fan experience and of course unlock commercial revenues that the current one cannot. It is one of many major plans Gerry Cardinale has to bring the Rossoneri back to the top of European football.

According to recent reports, beppe Marotta featured in the first episode of ‘L’impresa sportiva’, a segment on Il Sole 24 ORE’s TV program dedicated to the world of sport. He spoke about foreign ownership in Italy and the upcoming stadium project, with his words via MilanPress.

“Football is a powerfully unifying phenomenon. After religion, I believe only sport can unite people by breaking down barriers. However, it’s also become a business. There are 12 foreign owners out of 20 in Serie A,” he began.

Sources indicate that “On the one hand, there’s a decline, on the other, we have to ask ourselves what would have happened to football in Italy without these foreign owners. It’s no coincidence that the future stadium is a joint venture between the two Milan clubs, both of which have American owners with, frankly, very farsighted vision.

Recent findings suggest that “The stadium is the icon, the biggest investment, the most spendable, and the one everyone pays most attention to. Presently, the European club with the highest matchday revenue is Real Madrid, which closed its last financial year with around €240 million.

Industry observers note that “We’re at €100 million, which means a gap of €140 million. The stadium must also be beautiful, welcoming, and safe. It must bring prosperity. Maximum respect for San Siro and for the emotions I felt as a child.

“But we must look forward: it is a modern stadium, which will make all its customers happy, that is, the fans of both clubs.
