📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that after a humiliating defeat by Grimsby Town in their previous League Cup campaign, Manchester United found a different way to exit the competition this time around. The jeers heard at the full-time whistle after throwing away a two-goal lead pointed to more worrying times a year on from Blundell Park.

For the first time in half a century, United lost a game at Old Trafford having led 2-0, highlighting the defensive problems Michael Carrick needs to solve after turning results around last season.

“What the f---ing hell was that?” shouted the home fans, in a chant that may have been aimed at the referee but equally applied to United’s players, who led through Shea Lacey and Mason Mount’s early goals.

Brighton cut through Carrick’s defence several times before staging their comeback with goals from Charalampos Kostoulas, Pascal Gross and Maxim De Cuyper. Carrick and his analysts will rewatch the footage of all three goals in horror at how they conceded.

Recent findings suggest that kostoulas halves the deficit! 🔵Brighton score on the stroke of half-time. pic.twitter.com/bGjN1w6s6c.

It has been revealed that “I totally understand the feelings of the supporters,” Carrick said. “We have to accept it. I totally accept it. It’s on me ultimately: as a team what we look like, how we play and what results you get. I take that. I’ll take the praise, I’ll take the criticism and the upset.”.

In a recent development, erik ten Hag used the domestic cups to taste success while struggling in the Premier League, but one of those opportunities is now lost to Carrick, who must be careful not to spiral from a poor start to the campaign into crisis. Sunday’s trip to Fulham before the international break now feels like a substantial game for United and Carrick.

“We’ve gone out of the cup and the feeling around the place feels bigger than that,” Carrick said. “I’ll be honest about that, that’s how it feels, but it doesn’t have to be like that. If we win football matches again, it can go in a different direction.

“We have a substantial game on Sunday that we have to prepare for. We’re out of this competition and we have to go back to winning football matches.

Sources indicate that “It doesn’t feel good at the moment. It doesn’t feel good. We have to go back to winning football matches. We want to win and want to win rapidly. The next game is Sunday. That’s all I’m thinking about right now.”.

In a recent development, at the start of the evening it seemed that the tie would be remembered for Lacey scoring on his first start for United, the first teenager to do so since Marcus Rashford. In the week when JJ Gabriel, one of United’s great academy talents, asked to leave the club, a different United teenager was kissing the badge when he found the net.

According to recent reports, SHEA LACEY ON HIS FIRST START!!! 🔴🌟What a hit from the 19-year-old to open the scoring for Man Utd! pic.twitter.com/Ex2ceXaUge.

Industry observers note that mason Mount DOUBLES Man Utd's lead! 🤩 pic.twitter.com/c83ggCb8Bf.

And after Mount’s strike it looked like United were cruising into the fourth round for their first knockout win in 19 months, since defeating Leicester City in the FA Cup last year. But Brighton’s way back into the game was to get Gross, 35, on the ball and the veteran German controlled the game.

Gross took his chance when United carelessly played the ball out of defence again, with Diogo Dalot’s clearance mishit. Luka Vuskovic’s header went straight into the United penalty area, with their centre-backs failing to react promptly enough.

Pascal Gross takes advantage of a gifted opportunity to level the score! 🔥 pic.twitter.com/Qu2E0B6060.

The turnaround was completed a few minutes later when De Cuyper found the net, finishing off a counter-attack in which Diego Gómez and Kostoulas raided the left flank of United before cutting the ball back.

Sources indicate that brighton have turned it around!!! 🔵A sensational comeback as Maxim De Cuyper makes it 3-2 at Old Trafford. pic.twitter.com/Bfcr4N7mTL.

It has been revealed that fabian Hürzeler’s side can be considered this season’s entertainers, with this comeback going with their seven-goal thriller against Chelsea, putting four past Aston Villa and five past Coventry at the weekend. Next for them in the League Cup is Manchester City or Norwich away, although they are unlikely to fear any opponents.

“We take it how it is. We want to go as far as possible but if you want to win something you have to win at the highest level,” Hürzeler said. “We have to stay very, very humble and get an understanding why we are at the place we are and getting the basics right and the small margins right. It is so vital we stay humble and then we can grow into the game.”.

For Carrick, matches such as this can define a United manager’s reign if he cannot turn results around. The image of Ruben Amorim in the dugout at Grimsby was one of the lasting impressions of last season before Carrick was brought in to salvage the campaign.

Sources indicate that “We can’t put ourselves in that position after being ahead in the game and the game finishing like it did,” he said. “So we’ve got to react to it. We’ve got another game on Sunday, we’ve got to react to it.”.

"We can't accept that" ❌"I take responsibility for that" 🗣️ Michael Carrick reacts to his side's defeat👇 pic.twitter.com/OheT8yUK7y.

Recent findings suggest that I think we’ve got to be a little bit careful on that one. He’s a 15-year-old boy. It’s more about the welfare and the care of JJ as a child really, or certainly a young man. The situation is what it is, but we’ve got to be a little bit careful of the exposure and how we jump on that.

Recent findings suggest that the start of the game and the end of the game was completely different, didn’t feel like the same game or the same emotions at all. We had the game exactly where we wanted it and let it get away from us in a big way.

There’s a number of things we’ll look at, we’ll dissect and I know quite a bit of where it went wrong. We can’t accept that as a group. I take responsibility, the performance towards the second half that’s on me. We’ll have to get better, we have a significant game on Sunday that we have to prepare for. We’re out of this competition and we have to get back to winning football matches.

We’ve got to keep evolving as a group. We have to keep learning and dealing with situations. Sometimes they come a bit easier than others. Tonight was a tough one. We didn’t find a way out of it. That’s up to me and the staff to help the players and guide them through it. I think we all know that in the end tonight feels like a substantial disappointment.

According to recent reports, we’ve had small, little things that have gone against us in the last week or two and then it accumulates to feel that it’s a lot bigger. I think we have to be honest and say that. The late goal against Everton from outside the box. The [Manchester] City goal the other day. Gerry Cardinale declared that AC Milan will alter the way they strategy for preseason, but what exactly could that mean?

According to recent reports, as La Gazzetta dello Sport write, the pile of rubble created six months ago by Milan’s defeat to Cagliari brought about a managerial and sporting revolution, and it is still going on. Cardinale continues to alter the way the club do things, hoping to evolve into an efficient and successful organisation.

Read SempreMilan ad-free and get access to exclusive news. Click here for a free trial!

In his interview with the newspaper a few days ago, the owner extended the discussion even to the scheduling of preseason tours, stating: “Those two million for a friendly match overseas will no longer be our objective, as they were in the past.”.

Beyond the actual practical implications, these words reveal a new stance: from now on, throughout the summer, sporting priorities will take precedence over financial ones. In other words, if the opportunity arises to play a friendly match outside of Europe, Amorim will be consulted.

The Rossoneri also intend to become an active participant in organising their own summer commitments. They will no longer simply put forward their availability in exchange for an offer from some tournament, but rather being the architects of their own program.

These details clearly illustrate the ownership’s shift, but in recent days there is talk of a €70m bid for Endrick, the €60m pursuit of Nicolo Tresoldi and the potential €40m acquisition of Goncalo Inacio, the money has to keep coming in.

It has been revealed that cardinale injected €50m in equity into the club’s coffers, earmarked for sports needs. This injection was made to make up for the loss of Champions League revenue. It’s the first time RedBird has injected cash for this purpose, with the other being €55m to buy land in San Donato.

It has been revealed that that’s why, in this context, it’s no longer surprising when Cardinale claims that ‘those €2m paid for a friendly match overseas will no longer be our goal’. The bar has been raised, with the aim of trophies being raised down the line.

  • It has been revealed that “Lo scudetto è assolutamente possibile, al cento per cento.
  • It has been revealed that ma non sono solo i numeri a dircelo.

Era fine ottobre quando Gerry Cardinale ruppe la consueta cantilena sui non obiettivi delle varie squadre. Il numero uno del Milan parlò candidamente di Scudetto, per la sua squadra. Il tutto mentre il gruppo di Amorim era reduce dalla sconfitta contro il Bologna, quindi non proprio nel miglior momento della stagione.

It has been revealed that “Lo scudetto è assolutamente possibile, al cento per cento. E lo dico senza voler essere arrogante. Mi sveglio ogni mattina sperando in un piccolo spiraglio, ovvero che l’Inter cominci a pareggiare invece di vincere e che noi cominciamo a mettere insieme una serie di successi”. Da quel giorno il suo Milan ha inanellato tre vittorie consecutive in campionato, assestandosi a 5 dalla vetta. Numeri alla mano, lo Scudetto è possibile.

It has been revealed that ma non sono solo i numeri a dircelo. La sensazione, guardando le ultime sfide dei rossoneri, è di avere di fronte una squadra in costante crescita, che si conosce sempre meglio col passare dei giorni e che soprattutto abbia capito il tipo di calcio che vuole fare. Il Milan che ha abbattuto il Frosinone è squadra consapevole, di qualità, in grado di esaltare i suoi uomini migliori. Da Modric a Moreira, ora anche Pulisic e Ramos. Il lavoro di Amorim sembra dare risultati. E allora oggi, a sole tre partite di distanza, quelle parole di Cardinale sembrano avere un suono diverso.

Akram Jadid’s name has been in the headlines again recently, and for good reason given his exploits on international duty.

Calciomercato.com begin a report by stating that Ruben Amorim had already made a note of Jadid’s qualities, given that he called him up to first team training at the end of August, just days before the win against Venezia.

The coach has been ‘bewitched’ by the young talent, and it was a first opportunity for the teenager to work with the senior side. The staff also got to see exactly what level he is at, given that his scoring record gave him a reputation after netting over 700 goals in the lower levels.

Industry observers note that jadid represents another diamond in the youth sector for Milan, one that needs to be nurtured in the best possible way. Having risen up the age groups, he is at the moment a key player in Vito Michele Antonelli’s U18 team.

Last season, he was a key figure in the U15’s Scudetto victory, thanks in part to his goal in the final against Empoli. The fact he has been promoted multiple levels since says a lot about how he is through of internally.

The report described Jadid as ‘a lively, mobile left winger who enjoys constantly taking on opponents to create numerical superiority and finish, or pass (depending on the situation). He is a No.10 for his technical ability and vision, and a No.9 in the penalty area for his eye for goal’.

Industry observers note that in this first part of the season, Jadid has made eight appearances – all as a starter – and has scored four goals against Atalanta, Inter and Lecce. He continued this good form for his country with a hat-trick for Morocco U17s in the Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers victory over Tunisia.

The third goal was particularly impressive: after anticipating the opposing defender and pounced on a loose ball, Jadid moved inside, evaded the return of another opponent, and concluded his solo effort with a curling right-footed shot that left the goalkeeper with no chance.

What comes next? For now, Akram Jadid will continue to grow with the U18 side, but the plan is that in the coming weeks he will be tested in the Primavera, so as to be able to compete against an even higher level of opponents.

Industry observers note that amorim is keeping an eye on him. Given his propensity for working with young players and instilling their trust, it cannot be ruled out that Jadid could appear on the list of players called up for a Serie A match in the near future.

For now, the parallel with Francesco Camarda – another record-holder from the Rossoneri youth team – is intriguing. Milan are enjoying him, and the Italian Federation are also monitoring things, as they could try to ‘steal’ him from Morocco.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Recent findings suggest that L’ingombrante presenza di Antonio Conte attorno alla panchina della Juve s’è dissolta.
  • Il più gettonato è Sorloth che l’Atletico Madrid è disposta a trattare.

Recent findings suggest that L’ingombrante presenza di Antonio Conte attorno alla panchina della Juve s’è dissolta. Almeno per il momento. Spalletti l’ha rimandato in tribuna grazie a un secondo tempo convincente, a una vittoria rotonda contro il Venezia. Tutto bene? Tutto a posto? Assolutamente no e l’allenatore della Juventus lo sa. Per far spegnere le voci e chiudere il dibattito servono i risultati, deve crescere soprattutto il gioco non bello neppure ieri con un primo tempo inguardabile. Cosa serve? Spalletti l’ha detto chiaro e tondo, gli manca un centravanti fisico, capace di vincere i duelli, di stare spalle alla porta per aprire spazi ai compagni e soprattutto capace di vedere la porta. Nessuno dei tre in rosa, neppure il giovane Ekhator, ha queste caratteristiche e allora l’allenatore non l’ha mandato a dire ai dirigenti della Juve.

Ma chi ha queste caratteristiche? Il più gettonato è Sorloth che l’Atletico Madrid è disposta a trattare. La Juve lo vorrebbe in prestito con diritto. Per qualcuno anche Varela potrebbe essere finito nel mirino, ma l’investimento sarebbe troppo alto e quattro mesi di serie A forse sono pochi per una valutazione congrua. Ma i dirigenti bianconeri vogliono andare oltre Spalletti, è evidente che per completare la rosa servano un esterno sinistro per il deludente Cambiaso e un regista più vivo di un Douglas Luiz poco dinamico. I nomi in pole position sono quelli di Udogie del Tottenham e del danese Hojbjerg sul quale però dall’estate scorsa c’è anche la Fiorentina. Si tratta di capire se i viola hanno strappato o meno qualche impegno prima dell’interesse dei bianconeri. Anche il Milan che ha divertito battendo e sommergendo di reti il Frosinone per una volta ingenuo, vuol fare un grande mercato. Da quando Cardinale ha preso direttamente le redini del club c’è un’energia nuova e tante risorse. L’idea è chiara, riportare il Milan al livello dell sua storia e del brand anche in Europa e non solo in Italia. Per farlo, ovvio, servono campioni e grandi giocatori. Vista l’incertezza di Tresoldi, ma non solo, aumenta l’innamoramento di Cardinale per Endrick. Il brasiliano del Real Madrid l’ha stregato, la richiesta è arrivata direttamente a Florentino Perez e pure Mourinho sembra essersi arreso. “Lo terrei, ma se il club vuole fare altrimenti…”, parole chiare che avvicinano il ragazzo al Milan. Ma non basta. I riflettori sono accesi anche su Bruno Fernandes che non vuole rinnovare con il Manchester. Arriverà a parametro zero o è possibile trovare una soluzione poco onerosa già per gennaio vista la situazione complicatissima del club inglese? Lo vedremo, ma se il Milan pensa allo scudetto la classifica corta e il crescere della qualità delle prestazioni autorizzano a crederci. E se è vero che davanti hanno vinto tutte, invece la superfavorita Inter dopo aver perso il Derby continua a lasciare qualcosa per strada. Ieri sera s’è fatta riprendere dall’Atalanta (rocambolesco 4-4) dopo essere stata nettamente in vantaggio e nonostante un grande Pio Esposito. Il vistoso calo di concentrazione a certi livelli è inaccettabile, anche l’allenatore con i troppi cambi ha dato segnali sbagliati, forse pensava che la partita fosse già vinta. Merito dell’Atalanta che non ha mai mollato, ma la gestione della gara dell’Inter è stata pessima segno che quando arriva la Champions qualcosa si inceppa nella testa dei nerazzurri, faticano a gestire due impegni ravvicinati di alto livello. E uscito Calhanoglu ancora infortunato, è mancata la luce. Per sostituirlo nel ruolo curiosa la scelta di Sucic e non di Stankovic, decisione che sa di bocciatura. E’ tornato invece a vincere il Napoli con un corto muso caro ad Allegri, ma pure qui il problema del gol sta diventando sempre più evidente. Che fare? De Laurentiis sarebbe pronto a investire su Varela, gli piace, lo avrebbe convinto. Il Monza chiede una cifra vicina ai trenta milioni, un’enormità, però Manna non s’è spaventato. Si cerca una soluzione praticabile già per gennaio con Lucca nel piatto e un altro giocatore che può essere Giovane. Non sarà facile, il Monza punta al cash. E stasera la giornata chiude proprio con il Monza e il cannoniere Varela che vorrà mettersi ancora di più in evidenza contro la Fiorentina dalla difesa di burro. Gara che diventa così scivolosa per la Viola che deve assolutamente vincere per lasciare le zone pericolose. Dopo due mesi Vanoli recupera un giocatore fondamentale come Atta almeno per la panchina.

Le parole di Abate nel post-partita con il Napoli accendono i riflettori sulle condizioni di Belghali e Ismajli verso la sfida contro i biancocelesti; stop muscolare pure per Biraghi.

In vista della sfida di sabato 28 novembre alle 18:00, valida per la 13ª giornata di Serie A, che vedrà i biancocelesti impegnati nella trasferta sul campo del Torino, le condizioni fisiche in casa granata assumono un peso specifico notevole per la Lazio, chiamata a guardare con attenzione alle possibili assenze emerse dopo la gara con il Napoli.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Al termine della partita di ieri sera contro i partenopei, il tecnico Abate ha fatto chiarezza sulle condizioni di due elementi della rosa: "Belghali si porta dietro un problema al ginocchio da settimane, Ismajli potrebbe essersi rotto un dito della mano". Due situazioni da valutare giorno per giorno che interessano da vicino anche la Lazio: Belghali stava attraversando un ottimo momento di forma prima dello stop, mentre Ismajli si è fin qui dimostrato il più affidabile e brillante del terzetto difensivo granata. La loro assenza sarebbe un duro colpo per il Torino nella sfida contro i biancocelesti.

Industry observers note that sempre dopo la sfida con il Napoli, l'allenatore granata ha aggiunto un ulteriore aggiornamento chiave per la preparazione della Lazio: "Biraghi ha avuto un affaticamento". Un problema muscolare che impone cautela in settimana per evitare ricadute e che mette a rischio la sua presenza per la 13ª giornata di campionato, togliendo potenzialmente esperienza e spinta sulla fascia ai granata nel confronto con i biancocelesti.

#72766. Tech Report: Floyd Samba’s Man City debut double has father Chris dancing

Tech Report: Floyd Samba’s Man City debut double has father Chris dancing

📅 17 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 21 min read (4109 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~21 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • There was very much a Samba beat to this Manchester City victory – and it almost had a famous father in the crowd up dancing.
  • This was a night when Brazilian Allan Elias scored his first goal on an enterprising first appearance for City.
  • But it was another debutant who stole the show as the Carabao Cup holders sailed past Norwich City to set up a fourth-round meeting with Brighton.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

There was very much a Samba beat to this Manchester City victory – and it almost had a famous father in the crowd up dancing.

This was a night when Brazilian Allan Elias scored his first goal on an enterprising first appearance for City.

But it was another debutant who stole the show as the Carabao Cup holders sailed past Norwich City to set up a fourth-round meeting with Brighton.

Floyd Samba scored two fine goals and had a hand in another on a dream debut that had his beaming dad up off his seat and thrusting his arms in the air as if ready to party.

If the Samba surname feels familiar, that is because Floyd’s father Christopher played more than 200 games for Blackburn Rovers, Queens Park Rangers and Aston Villa.

In fact, it was very much a family affair as Floyd’s brothers Tyrone and Emerson, who are also in City’s academy and hoping one day to tread a similar path, joined in the jubilant celebrations alongside their mother, a visibly emotional Theresa.

This particular evening belonged to Floyd, though. Deployed as a lone striker by Enzo Maresca, you would not have known he ordinarily plays as a midfielder such was the confidence and composure the 17-year-old oozed.

Norwich could not live with him or City for that matter as Maresca’s impressive start as manager since replacing Pep Guardiola continued apace.

According to recent reports, this must have been an incredibly satisfying moment for Samba Sr. He came through incredible hardship – at one stage as a teenager he was rough-sleeping – to forge an impressive career totalling more than 450 games for club and country.

According to recent reports, so to be in a position to now have three sons in City’s academy and one produce a debut like this will fill him with enormous pride. Floyd was later seen enjoying a warm embrace with his dad in the crowd, moments after being congratulated by Tyrone, a year his senior, and 12-year-old Emerson, who plays for City’s Under-13s.

“I knew there would be an opportunity to get some minutes for the first time with the first team – to get a debut like that is mind blowing,” Samba said. “I couldn’t believe it myself, but that’s just the beginning, I’ve got a major career ahead of me. It was a great debut.”.

Industry observers note that floyd caught the eye with a fine free-kick in City’s 2-1 FA Youth Cup final victory over Manchester United last season and now he has goals for the senior side to his name. Pretty stunning they were, too.

The first was a superbly steered header past two Norwich bodies on the line from Allan’s cross and the second a lovely, nonchalantly curled finish low into the far corner.

What a moment for Floyd Samba! 😍A goal on his Man City debut for the 17-year-old, son of former Blackburn defender Chris 🩵 pic.twitter.com/VCVfX9HCNn.

Chris Samba has deliberately kept a low profile, keen to let his sons get on with their own careers free of distractions, but there was no chance he was going to be able to suppress his emotions in that instant. And nor should he. It was some moment for the boy and his family.

It has been revealed that as impressed as Maresca was by the goals, it will have been other elements of Samba’s game that also caught the eye. He did extremely well to hold off the attentions of Norwich’s centre-backs when receiving a pass from Ayyoub Bouaddi and then returning the ball to the Moroccan who released Rayan Cherki through to score City’s second. His movement was also sharp, at one point taking a difficult pass sweetly in an adjusted strike, only for Norwich’s Bruno Alves to come across to make a timely intervention before Samba could get his shot off.

"Was there any doubt?"Ayyoub Bouaddi with his first assist for Man City as he sets up Rayan Cherki to make it 2-0 🔵 pic.twitter.com/0gfxp5GDXy.

Sources indicate that “It was satisfying not just for the two goals but for the entire performance,” Maresca stated. “He didn’t play many games as a nine but he was good. He’s young, full of energy, strong, he can finish.”.

According to recent reports, allan, a £34m summer signing from Palmeiras, will have been just as pleased with his contribution. Maresca’s fluid formation initially resembled a 3-1-5-1 with Allan effectively operating as a right wing-back but he stuck doggedly to the task before eventually getting the moment to showcase his quality, first with his cross for Samba and later with a neat solo run and finish.

Driving inside Sam Field and then cutting back inside the Norwich man before curling an inch perfect finish into the bottom corner – all of it done with his left foot – it was quite the introduction.

In a recent development, allan on his debut! 🇧🇷Magic from the Brazilian to make it 3-0 to Man City 💥 pic.twitter.com/nw6lNqh1yL.

Hugo Viana, City’s director of football, has said supporters will need to be patient with Allan and that it may take the 22-year-old time to adjust to English football but this first outing will do his confidence plenty of good.

“It was crucial for him to play 90 minutes and to see a little bit the English competition that is a bit different from South America so overall was good,” Maresca mentioned.

Cherki was the only survivor from the team that started Sunday’s victory over Manchester United but it all felt pretty seamless from City. Bouaddi, the £85m signing from Lille, was poised and graceful in midfield alongside the impressive Mateo Kovacic and Geronimo Rulli could not have asked for a much quieter debut in goal.

FLOYD SAMBA again!! 🌟The 17-year-old curls one in to score his second on his Man City debut with his dad Christopher watching on in the stands 👏 pic.twitter.com/fJ5mfEWBx1.

According to recent reports, nico O’Reilly looked like he had barely broken a sweat despite Norwich’s players routinely being unable to keep up with him. Norwich themselves made nine changes but the gulf in class was enormous and testament to City’s strength in depth.

The game also gave Maresca the opportunity to give run outs to two more academy graduates who played in that Youth Cup final triumph, Kaden Braithwaite and Ryan McAidoo and the latter got his own name on the scoresheet to make it 5-0.

All told there were seven City academy graduates on the pitch, two of them playing for Norwich. This was certainly a night to remember for the club’s youth production line.

According to recent reports, with the dominant performance, Man City have earned themselves the privilege of hosting Brighton in the next round, who will no doubt prove a much stiffer challenge than Norwich. They become the sixth all-Premier League tie in the next round, with only Fleetwood, Bradford and Peterborough remaining from outside the top flight:.

Possession: Man City 66% vs 34% Norwich.

Touches inside opposition box: 30 vs 4.

Sources indicate that erling Haaland left out of the squad, watching from the stands, would have enjoyed that performance from Floyd Samba. Here is his second goal for you to enjoy on his debut night:.

FLOYD SAMBA again!! 🌟The 17-year-old curls one in to score his second on his Man City debut with his dad Christopher watching on in the stands 👏 pic.twitter.com/fJ5mfEWBx1.

Five unanswered goals and a home-grown hero emerges for Manchester City!

Great through ball from O’Reilly, which Lewis lets run past him for the dummy. McAidoo runs on to it on the right of the box and first-time fires it low into the far corner.

It has been a perfect night for Manchester City’s academy.

Well we look like we’re heading for a matching scoreline to the previous edition of the fixture. That pesky shot on target is still eluding Norwich, whereas Samba is still out there looking for his hat-trick.

Two minutes of time to be added – who will get there first?

O’Reilly sends a high, looping ball to the back post from the left side, where McAidoo rushes to meet it but can’t get over it under pressure.

Final change for Norwich, as Kvistgaarden who has not had much service tonight, comes off for Schwartau.

Bouaddi sends a looping ball across the field to McAidoo, which he picks up on the edge of the box, but he is unable to get the ball under control to take his shot and it is cleared away as far as another City shirt.

The corner comes in to the centre of the box but is headed out by a City shirt.

It’s all slightly too little too late for Norwich.

They get another corner as Musaba tries to send a cross into the box from the right and it is blocked out.

Sources indicate that A free-kick for Norwich now as O’Reilly commits the foul 35 yards out. It goes in towards McConville at the back post, but Ait-Nouri heads it out for a Norwich corner.

Sources indicate that mo Touré strays just offside on the edge of the box, as Musaba sends a lovely little ball over to find him on the turn and the forward slots it past Rulli. Celebrations don’t quite begin before the flag goes up but that is a shame for the visitors.

Norwich have managed to get more of a grip in this half, despite conceding two more goals, but they are still without a shot on goal as we approach the final 15 minutes.

Another round of changes for both sides.

Man City take off scorer of their third goal Allan to bring on Braithwaite.

Norwich replace Ben Slimane and Bruno Alves with Touré and McConville.

Industry observers note that samba again at the heart of the action, laying off the ball to McAidoo on the right for the winger to run into the box. His shot towards the far post is saved low by Grimshaw who spills it almost into the path of Lewis, but Norwich survive.

Lewis makes a run down the right-hand side and crosses into Samba on the edge of the box. He lays off to McAidoo, but his shot goes sailing over the bar.

A surprise to no one, it is chucking it down in Manchester.

Sources indicate that big cheers from the away end as Norwich get their first corner of the evening. It is lofted high and long to the back post, where it is headed away by Bouaddi. It bounces out to Musaba, who has just come on, and he strikes it from the top of the box on the half-volley.

His shot cuts through a crowd in the box and has Rulli diving to his left, but it goes wide of the post. What an introduction that would have been!

According to recent reports, well all the stories from this match will be all about young Floyd Samba. Feel free to leave your best punny Samba/dance-related headlines in the comments section.

For Man City as you would expect it is all about game management from here on out.

Some more changes to report for Norwich as well, as Crnac is replaced by Musaba.

Wright is able to run in to space towards the edge of the box, but as has been their story all evening, his pass out to the wing is just not where it needs to be and their effort just breaks down.

Sources indicate that what a way to score a second! A night to remember for Floyd Samba!

It has been revealed that norwich try and play out from the back but far too sloppy and Ait-Nouri picks up the ball on the left of the box. He has plenty of time to tee up Samba inside the box at the left corner, who finds himself with plenty of space to curl his shot into the far corner, beating the diving Grimshaw.

We may be seeing plenty more of him this season.

Industry observers note that norwich looking for their way back into the game, as the ball comes down the left, fizzed in low and flashes past Rulli, trying to claim it. It deflects off a crowd of bodies and spins up, but Fisher can’t connect and it spins away harmlessly wide of the goal.

It is definitely Norwich’s best chance of the game and Fisher will be upset he hasn’t made more of that.

According to recent reports, and Allan makes it three! Minutes after the restart, the Brazilian makes his own mark on his debut.

It has been revealed that maresca switched him onto the left side to escape Yongwa, and he picks up the ball outside the box and makes the run inside. He runs circles around Field and slots the ball home into the far bottom corner.

Recent findings suggest that some changes from both sides at half-time. McAidoo comes on for Cherki, though O’Reilly is the one to move up into midfield to fill the gap.

Norwich take off Diallo for Maghoma.

45 minutes left for the visitors to create something special!

What a moment for Floyd Samba! 😍A goal on his Man City debut for the 17-year-old, son of former Blackburn defender Chris 🩵 pic.twitter.com/VCVfX9HCNn.

Manchester City will be the ones to host Brighton in the next round – giving the visitors the opportunity to pull off a remarkable feat of knocking out both Manchester sides should they win.

Enjoy the highlights from last night as they came from behind to dispatch Man Utd:.

Possession: Man City 72% vs 28% Norwich.

Touches inside opposition box: 15 vs 1.

And without much ado at the end of the half, we have reached the break. City put themselves in control with two quick-fire goals and it looks a tall task for Norwich to find their way back into the match.

Industry observers note that credit where it is due, Yongwa has been very good for Norwich. He has stood fast, made some very good challenges and stopped Allan getting much of a look-in on the right.

Recent findings suggest that as we approach half-time, the stats tell a sorry story. Norwich have had just 28% possession and created a single shot, none on target.

As City come again, Norwich have pulled every man back to try and keep the situation salvageable before the break.

Sources indicate that samba was in again there, making a run into the box with a ball from Cherki, wrestling with Bruno Alves as he goes. The defender does enough to throw him off and Grimshaw is able to come out and snatch the ball.

Man City are looking to close this out now, and they look threatening every time they break.

Ait-Nouri is the latest to try his luck, making a run into the box from the left, but his shot is blocked.

Recent findings suggest that A few minutes to remember here for Floyd Samba. First he steers home a very well taken header to give City the lead and then he plays a crucial role in the second, holding the ball up well before laying it off to Bouaddi to release Cherki to score. That’s how to make an impression on your debut.

In a recent development, and the floodgates have opened. Two goals in two minutes for the defending champions.

Recent findings suggest that samba finds Bouaddi in midfield, who takes it forward and feeds Cherki running to his left. He gets himself one-on-one and slots cool as you like into the bottom left corner.

City are in control all of a sudden and Norwich will be devastated.

As soon as I say that, Floyd Samba finds a way through.

In a recent development, he has looked the brightest for City, and O’Reilly sends a cross over the box from the left, drawing Grimshaw away from position. The ball is pinged back in by Allan and the youngster stoops to meet it, heading in to the bottom corner.

In a recent development, norwich have been very disciplined in defence so far. Yongwa has been closing down Allan on the wing very well.

Cherki is starting to get some momentum – but is swarmed by yellow shirts as he picks up the ball on the edge of the area.

It has been revealed that another loose ball from City in midfield and Norwich pick it up again. The ball to set the front line free is equally as loose from the visitors though and it breaks down once again.

Samba is looking lively, racing to get on a ball in front of Darling just on the edge of the box. Darling recovers to send it out for a corner, which becomes a free kick after Ait-Nouri wrestles his man to the ground at the back post as City are taking.

Wright sends a long ball across the field, looking for a man on the right side but Rulli is alert to it and comes to claim at the edge of the box.

Kovacic shows some promise with a strong run on the ball down the centre of the field, taking the ball all the way to the edge of the box, where he collides with a defender, and the ball spins away for Norwich to clear out.

This is better from City, who have looked like they’re lacking drive so far.

Yongwa again probing down the left side. It takes two to dispossess him and Man City manage to get the throw in, but approaching 20 minutes Norwich will be happy with this.

It has been revealed that kovacic loses the ball in midfield and Norwich surge forward. The move breaks down as Wright’s pass to Diallo on the wing is just behind him and he can’t take it forward into the box.

Spent the first 10 minutes trying to work out City’s system and settled on a 3-1-5-1, with Bouaddi operating as a nominal third centre-back, but it seems to have changed again now with O’Reilly dropping to left back and Bouaddi stepping into midfield. No doubt the metamorphosis will continue.

This Man City team have never played all together and it is clear that they’re still settling in here, figuring out how they’re going to press here.

Kovacic in the captain’s armband is tying it all together in midfield.

It has been revealed that khusanov threads a lovely ball to Samba who flicks it into the path of Lewis, who takes it and makes a run into the box. He creates space and sends a right-footed shot over the bar – but Man City are building.

It has been revealed that norwich make a move forward, with Yongwa bringing the ball down the left side but his cross into the box is blocked by Allan sliding in. The Brazilian is then fouled again as Yongwa tries to reclaim the ball and Man City get back in possession.

It’s actually three Samba brothers at City. The youngest, Emerson, is also in the academy.

Early foul on Allan gets Man City a free kick and they have started as everyone expected they would – in plenty of possession.

They look for the early goal as O’Reilly feeds him in the from the left side, but the shot is blocked.

We have kicked off in Manchester!

As Abdukodir Khusanov makes his fourth start of the season, Hugo Viana, Man City director of football, has been speaking about the young Uzbek. The 22-year-old signed a upcoming five-year contract with City in July, and Viana has affirmed that he “will be one of the best centre-backs in the world”.

"Abdukodir Khusanov will be one of the best centre-backs in the world" - Hugo Viana 🇺🇿🌏Full interview 🔗 https://t.co/dk3Qi8DF8D pic.twitter.com/hHdVdX5HSF.

It’s nine changes for Norwich from the squad that lost 4-3 to Middlesbrough on the weekend.

Norwich goalkeeper Daniel Grimshaw came through the ranks at Manchester City, joining as a teenager, so this will be a special night for the 28-year-old.

Recent findings suggest that speaking of Phil Foden, the winger will not be making an appearance tonight, as he is serving his three-match suspension following his sending off in the Manchester derby. The England international lashed out at Bruno Fernandes after the United captain had fouled him, resulting in a red card for violent conduct.

As well as this fixture, he will also be missing City’s game against Sunderland and the trip to Anfield to face Liverpool the following weekend.

We broke down the incident as it happened on Sunday and you can get the full story here.

Heavy squad rotation (10 changes in total for Maresca) has handed debuts for Gero Rulli in goal, as well as Allan and Floyd Samba in the outfield.

17-year-old Samba is the latest from City’s academy to be making his debut in the senior squad, following in the footsteps of Phil Foden, Rico Lewis, Nico O’Reilly and many more. A versatile midfielder, he has totalled 24 appearances across six competitions (incl Premier League 2) and scored 17 and assisted six goals in those matches.

It has been revealed that keep your eyes on young midfielder Floyd Samba, who has been handed his Manchester City debut tonight against Norwich by manager Enzo Maresca. Floyd is the 17 year old son of former Blackburn Rovers defender Christopher Samba.

His older brother Tyrone, 18, also plays for City. The siblings played in City’s FA Youth Cup final win over Manchester United last season, with Floyd scoring the first in a 2-1 win.

City fans will also be keen to see how Allan Elias gets on on his first start, having arrived from Palmeiras for £34m. Geronimo Rulli also debuts in goal.

In a recent development, good evening and welcome to another night of Carabao Cup coverage! It is the final fixture of round three (I promise) as Manchester City host Norwich.

These two sides have not met since 2022, when Norwich were still in the top flight and were beaten 4-0 by City. Looking at their previous meetings, the odds are definitely stacked in favour of Enzo Maresca’s side, who have scored 14 unanswered goals in their last three meetings with Norwich, while the Championship side have not scored any.

City will be looking to make it six straight wins across all competitions tonight, having started perfectly in the Premier League with four wins from four, and comfortably seeing off Porto in their Champions League opener.

They were the talk of the weekend with their deeply controversial 1-0 win over rivals Manchester United as – having gone down to 10 men after Phil Foden was sent off – their winning goal was allowed to stand despite Enzo Fernández being clearly in an offside position that impacted United’s keeper and backline.

Erling Haaland has put Manchester City ahead in the derby after a VAR check ⚽️ pic.twitter.com/V0DCwryhFy.

City are defending their title in this competition – beating Arsenal last year in the final – but like all Premier League teams playing in European competitions, have only entered the tournament this year in the third round.

Philippe Clement’s side beat MK Dons 4-1 in the first round, and followed that up with a 2-1 win over Cardiff City in the second to reach the Etihad tonight. The fourth-round draw has already been done, and it has been decided that the winner of this match will face Brighton.

But we have at least 90 minutes of the third round left before that, so without further ado, we’ll get underway and bring you team updates shortly!

  • After the attempt in the summer which failed, Milan seem ready for round two of their Inacio pursuit.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

A report from Portugal has claimed that Sporting CP will not stand in Goncalo Inacio’s way if he wishes to join AC Milan even in January.

After the attempt in the summer which failed, Milan seem ready for round two of their Inacio pursuit. The Rossoneri received a ‘no’ from Sporting towards the end of August but are determined to launch a fresh bid for the Portuguese international in the winter transfer window.

Read SempreMilan ad-free and get access to exclusive news. Click here for a free trial!

The Lions’ captain is someone that Amorim known well and believes will fit both his systems (the three and four-man defence) and his style of play. The idea is for Inacio to come in and start immediately, to bolster the rearguard.

It has been revealed that gerry Cardinale – the owner of AC Milan – still has the aim of providing Amorim with the best players to lead the team back to the Champions League next season. Meanwhile, Milan know in advance that the centre-back’s release clause is set at €60m.

As Record report, from Sporting’s side they are clear: the Lisbon club are willing to listen to offers and to let Inacio leave if they receive a significant sum in the winter transfer window.

Recent findings suggest that this season the Alcochete academy graduate was an undisputed starter under Rui Borges and will be under Paulo Fonseca too. Despite being called up by Jorge Jesus to the national team, Inácio has yet to play any minutes under the new coach.

The time might be right because of Inacio’s desire to pursue other opportunities, as well as the fact that he already worked with Amorim at Sporting between 2020 and 2024, where they won three league titles, two League Cups, one Portuguese Cup and one Super Cup together.

According to recent reports, doveva essere il momento più bello della sua carriera. Il Pallone d'Oro, il rinnovo con il Bayern Monaco fino al 2029, la consacrazione definitiva dopo anni vissuti da protagonista senza riuscire a conquistare un trofeo individuale di questa portata. E invece, per Harry Kane, novembre si è trasformato in un incubo. Il centravanti inglese si è procurato una lesione del legamento della sindesmosi della caviglia sinistra durante la sfida contro il Colonia. La diagnosi del Bayern parla di uno stop di diversi mesi: le stime della stampa tedesca arrivano a circa tre. C'è chi parla di quattro. Adesso dovrà fermarsi proprio mentre il Bayern si gioca una parte importante della stagione. E lo stesso Kane, dopo l'infortunio, ha affidato ai social il proprio stato d'animo, promettendo di trasformare questo ostacolo in un'occasione per tornare ancora più forte.

It has been revealed that vincent Kompany deve trovare immediatamente una soluzione. E non è semplice, perché l'infortunio di Kane si aggiunge a una situazione già complicata: Serge Gnabry e Ismael Saibari sono attesi al rientro soltanto nel 2027, mentre Luis Díaz sta recuperando da un problema muscolare. Anche Michael Olise ha accusato un problema al piede contro il Colonia, sebbene non sembri destinato a uno stop lungo. La prima alternativa porta a Lennart Karl. Il diciottenne ha già preso il posto di Kane dopo la sostituzione contro il Colonia e può essere utilizzato da falso nove, sfruttando la capacità di muoversi tra le linee e dialogare con gli esterni. Non è un centravanti classico, ma Kompany potrebbe puntare sulla mobilità del reparto. Emergenza, beninteso, mica soluzione definitiva. L'altro nome è Diaz stesso, anche lui da falso nueve, dietro ci sono dei giovani ma senza esperienza come Noah Codjo-Evora e il sedicenne Bastian Assomo.

It has been revealed that la domanda è inevitabile: il Bayern andrà sul mercato a gennaio? La dirigenza non ha chiuso la porta, ma nemmeno manifestato l'intenzione di correre subito ai ripari. Il presidente Herbert Hainer ha spiegato che il club è sempre nelle condizioni di intervenire, anche se non tutte le ciambelle, che siano state d'emergenza o di virtù, son state col buco. Occhio, italiane: spunta il nome di Nicolò Tresoldi, punta del Club Brugge, valutato sì 40-50 milioni di euro ma sognato e ambito anche dalla Nazionale di Roberto Mancini.

In a recent development, la Juventus si muoverà per una prima punta a gennaio. Dopo le trattative che vi abbiamo raccontato nei giorni scorsi, anche Luciano Spalletti si è esposto, dopo il successo sul Venezia: “Noi abbiamo bisogno di un giocatore lì perché non l'abbiamo comprato”, ha detto l’allenatore toscano tornando sulla campagna acquisti estiva.

L’analisi di Spalletti è poi proseguita: “Nel calcio d'oggi serve una punta fisica che sappia giocare spalle alla porta. Poi è inutile parlare di Spalletti via. C'è bisogno di gente fisica, che riceva la pallata addosso e sappia giocare con le mani addosso del centrale avversario. Ora è così. Si vince i duelli. Ci vuole gente fisica che vinca i duelli ed esca dalle mini prigioni che ci sono in campo”. Una richiesta chiara, con la società che già da qualche settimana ha attivato i contatti in questo senso.

Chi sono i nomi seguiti dalla Juventus? Uno è sempre quell’Alexander Sorloth dell’Atletico Madrid a lungo cercato in estate. In questo avvio di stagione con Simeone non sta trovando spazio, possibile che fra qualche settimana possa diventare un’occasione. Altro nome forte è Falorin Balogun, che il Monaco non svenderò nonostante una scarsa centralità nel progetto. In Italia potrebbero tornare a scaldarsi i nomi di Antonio Raimondo e Gianluca Scamacca, ma è soprattutto Gustavo Varela a stuzzicare le idee bianconere. Anche se per il suo cartellino serviranno fra i 30 ed i 40 milioni di euro.

It has been revealed that un video scherzoso pubblicato in estate sui social, un'indiscrezione lanciata in diretta televisiva e una secca smentita ufficiale. Il caso legato all'intervento chirurgico agli occhi di Nicolas Pepe ha acceso il fine settimana del calcio spagnolo, trasformandosi in poche ore da curiosità virale a un vero e proprio scontro tra il Villarreal e la stampa iberica.

It has been revealed that tutto è esploso domenica 22 novembre, durante la trasmissione televisiva della sfida tra Barcellona e Villarreal su DAZN Spagna. Nel corso del collegamento, i telecronisti hanno raccontato che l'operazione agli occhi a cui l'esterno ivoriano si era sottoposto nel mese di ottobre, costringendolo a saltare cinque gare ufficiali, fosse la diretta conseguenza di una bravata estiva, ad agosto, infatti, Pepe aveva pubblicato su Snapchat un filmato in cui osservava l'eclissi solare in Spagna senza gli appositi occhiali protettivi, scherzando con i tifosi francesi. In un attimo, l'indiscrezione ha fatto il giro del web. Nei primi minuti successivi al fischio finale, i principali portali sportivi spagnoli e i programmi radiofonici hanno cavalcato l'onda con toni leggeri e ironici, sui canali social di Marca sono apparsi commenti sarcastici sul fatto che l'attaccante, pur di ammirare l'eclissi, avesse finito per guardare le partite dal divano di casa, mentre negli studi di Radio MARCA l'intera vicenda veniva etichettata come "surreale", alimentando l'ilarità degli opinionisti e trasformando gli occhi dell'ex Arsenal in trending topic nazionale.

In a recent development, quello che per i media sembrava un semplice aneddoto colorito ha però mandato su tutte le furie sia il diretto interessato sia i vertici del "Sottomarino Giallo". Come ricostruito dal quotidiano AS, il clamore mediatico e le battute circolate in rete hanno fatto esplodere il malcontento nello spogliatoio e in società, infastiditi dalla leggerezza con cui venivano diffuse notizie infondate sulla salute di un tesserato. In serata è così arrivato il comunicato ufficiale del Villarreal. Una nota dai toni duri, ripresa tempestivamente da tutte le testate nazionali, da Mundo Deportivo a Superdeporte, fino a 20minutos, in cui il club ha smentito categoricamente qualsiasi legame tra l'intervento oculistico e l'eclissi solare, chiarendo che l'operazione era stata pianificata da tempo per ragioni cliniche ben precise. Soprattutto, la società ha rivolto un richiamo esplicito ai giornalisti, chiedendo "rigore e responsabilità" nel trattare questioni mediche. Un monito che ha costretto le redazioni spagnole a un immediato dietrofront, archiviando i toni ironici per ricordare come già lo scorso 10 ottobre, alla vigilia della gara contro il Real Madrid, il club avesse regolarmente annunciato la natura programmata dell'intervento.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Thomas Tuchel faces a fight to regain the full trust of his England players, despite claiming that “99.9 per cent” of supporters do not talk about the semi-final defeat by Argentina.

Telegraph Sport reported that players were shocked and disappointed by Tuchel’s approach to the final 30 minutes of the World Cup semi-final.

It can now be revealed that doubts linger among England players over Tuchel’s ability to get the best out of his squad and ultimately lead them to glory in the next European Championship.

There is also some lasting unhappiness over Tuchel’s perceived unwillingness to take ultimate responsibility for England’s World Cup exit and his claim that ball possession was not in “the DNA” of the nation’s players.

In a recent development, tuchel has spoken of fostering a “brotherhood” within the England squad, but a source told Telegraph Sport: “He still has work to do to get all the players fully behind him again. What happened at the World Cup and some of his comments caused some damage that has not just disappeared.”.

According to recent reports, tuchel has no concerns over the commitment of his players and stated: “I have no doubt how keen they are. No doubt. I know them, I was seven weeks with them. We had a qualification campaign together, we are 18 months together, I have no doubt that we step up and produce performances in the next cycle. I’m responsible for that.”.

One player who did not travel to the World Cup and is not part of Tuchel’s latest England squad for four Nations League games is Morgan Gibbs-White. His partner, Britney De Villiers, took a swipe at Tuchel by posting an image on Instagram that referenced the fact the Nottingham Forest man is the only Premier League player to have created five or more chances in every match he has played this season.

There is no immediate sign that Tuchel is ready to change his approach, as he refused to accept the country were angered by his tactics and substitutions in the Argentina game.

In an attempt to gloss over the nature of England’s missed opportunity in the United States, Tuchel claimed that the bronze-medal victory over France was “one of the nicest experiences ever” for supporters and that he did not lose any sleep over his World Cup squad selection.

Tuchel’s defence of the World Cup campaign also included the revelation that his Football Association bosses had assured the England head coach that his job was safe before the last-16 victory over Mexico.

“I tell you something, like 99.9 per cent of the fans don’t speak about substitutions, tactical twists,” Tuchel remarked. “They speak about where they have watched the Mexico game, they speak about the second half, the energy of the Croatia match, they speak about how nerve-wracking it was to watch our match against Congo and where they celebrated.

According to recent reports, “This is how it should be, this is what a World Cup is for, to connect with the people and to give them experiences that they will not forget. And this is the feedback that I get.”.

According to recent reports, asked if he had received any negative feedback at all since the World Cup, Tuchel answered: “No. Not at all. Do you think that’s necessary? I had some quite bad stuff between Argentina and France. [But] No [not since I’ve been back in England].”.

The FA publicly backed Tuchel after the defeat by Argentina, but the German has now revealed that he was privately told his job was safe well before that.

Even if England had lost to Mexico and failed to reach the last eight of the World Cup, Tuchel has claimed he would not have been sacked. He said: “There was a moment, a very special moment, before the Mexico game where we had a talk and my bosses told me ‘we know that anything can happen in a football match, we know that anything can happen in a match in Mexico, in a World Cup match, but don’t worry, we see what’s going on and we want to continue like this’.

“It was a beautiful moment for me as a coach. I felt this kind of freedom to take my choices and to just coach freely, and there was never a doubt in my mind that we would continue together and there was obviously never a doubt in their mind.”.

England secured their best World Cup finish since 1966 by winning the bronze-medal game against France in a chaotic match in Miami.

“If you look at the 6-4 against France, people talk about it like it’s one of their nicest experiences ever, to watch a football match,” Tuchel noted. “So maybe I have to compromise in my wish for control, for a little bit more chaos, embrace the chaos, and maybe it brings out the best.”.

Tuchel has named his first England squad since the World Cup for four Nations League games against Spain, Czech Republic (home and away) and Croatia. He has recalled Cole Palmer and Trent Alexander-Arnold to his squad, but insists he has lost no sleep over not taking the pair to the World Cup.

“I was very happy with the [World Cup] squad selection, we put a lot of effort and emphasis into the squad selection,” Tuchel said. “And I had a lot of sleepless nights, but I had not one sleepless night about our selection, because I was more than seven weeks with this group of players, and they were nothing but fantastic. I think the spirit that we built and the mentality that we indicated brought us to the place that we got.

“It feels unfulfilled, but, yeah, that’s how it is. We need to move forward with the decisions in the Argentina game. And sometimes as a coach, you can only win if you win. So now we know the result, and we didn’t win. Of course, I reflect and, of course, I’m very critical of myself. But the question that is also still lingering around is, who knows what would have happened? Who knows if we hadn’t made any substitutions what would have happened? And would we have the same sleepless nights?

“So, there’s not much sense in torturing ourselves, looking back. It’s moving forward, but the team, like I stated, did brilliantly. And I will not allow 30 minutes against Argentina to override how we view this World Cup.”.

It has been revealed that tuchel had warnings for Palmer and Alexander-Arnold, as he stated: “It is one thing to be nominated, by the way, with Cole and getting your ticket back in the squad, but it’s another thing to play and keep your place. It’s about when he comes and he needs to show these kinds of performances.”.

Recent findings suggest that on Alexander-Arnold, Tuchel added: “Now it’s time to fight for his place. He always noted he’s up for a fight, especially for England. So it’s a need to prove that.”.

Recent findings suggest that tuchel mentioned that Alexander-Arnold has been called up as a right-back, rather than a midfielder. Asked if the Real Madrid player offers enough defensively, he answered by saying: “He has to, he has to. It’s necessary. My conviction is that he will, but he has no choice.”.

Tuchel has now finished his broadcast duties. It was quite a strange performance from him. I don’t recall ever seeing him read from notes before. His little joke about his bosses telling him off was awkward and felt rehearsed, and the stuff about 99.9 per cent of England fans talking about Mexico and the second half against Croatia was delusional.

Industry observers note that it was also jarring to hear him claim that the FA had basically assured Tuchel that his job was safe straight after England beat Mexico. It was a special night, undoubtedly, but did it really deserve that sort of reaction?

According to recent reports, “I wanted to give Jarrad a chance. It was a 51 per cent decision on Jarrad.

“I don’t have a clear picture on what he is all about and have a very clear picture on what Levi can bring us.”.

Recent findings suggest that “It makes no sense to nominate three, four, five number 10s. It just does not help anyone. We can see the form that Morgan [Gibbs-White] is in.

“It’s one thing to be nominated, but it’s another thing to perform. This also counts, especially Cole needs to step up to justify the nomination.”.

Sources indicate that “The minimum I can do is back my bosses. They have my full support on that.

“I’m grateful that I can talk about football because that’s my little bit of knowledge, not sports politics.”.

According to recent reports, “That’s the beauty of high-level sport, you can’t always win and it makes you feel alive. Not in a very nice way, still you feel that pain of these high-pressure moments.

“As soon as you enter knockout football, it’s a newly introduced level of pressure.”.

Tuchel has now claimed that people say the 6-4 against France is “maybe one of their best experiences (watching football) ever”.

Again, not something anyone has stated to me. Where is Tuchel finding these people?!

Tuchel: “There was never a doubt in my mind that we would continue together and there was obviously never a doubt in their (the FA’s) mind.”.

Tuchel says the direction in sports is always forwards and never backwards. “The target is to win the home Euros, of course.”.

There’s a return to the Three Lions squad for a number of players following the start of the newly introduced campaign with their clubs, with the likes of Cole Palmer, Dominic Calvert-Lewin, Lewis Hall, Rio Ngumoha, Jarrad Branthwaite, Myles Lewis-Skelly and Alex Scott all selected.

Pellegatti: Calvelli, Amorim, Krösche – why it may have been ‘better to lose against Cagliari’

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Carlo Pellegatti has painted a positive picture regarding AC Milan’s developments, one that puts last season’s collapse into perspective.
  • Rewinding to the end of May, it felt like Milan’s entire world have caved in.
  • Read SempreMilan ad-free and get access to exclusive news.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Carlo Pellegatti has painted a positive picture regarding AC Milan’s developments, one that puts last season’s collapse into perspective.

Rewinding to the end of May, it felt like Milan’s entire world have caved in. A 2-1 defeat at home to Cagliari – a game that they led in early on – in the final round of the season condemned the Rossoneri to a fifth-placed finish, meaning they missed out on Champions League football again.

Read SempreMilan ad-free and get access to exclusive news. Click here for a free trial!

Industry observers note that this is after Massimiliano Allegri had the team in a title fight going into the Spring, but ultimately the decline was near-vertical towards the end of the campaign. He paid the price for this, as did the CEO Giorgio Furlani, sporting director Igli Tare and chief scout Geoffrey Moncada.

In his latest column for MilanNews, Carlo Pellegatti has put forward the notion that the defeat to the Sardinians might turn out to be a blessing. Why? Because the reset that followed on a sporting and managerial level seems to already be taking a positive shape.

“Krosche and delight! It’s a somewhat obvious joke, but it captures the expectations of AC Milan fans. When will he arrive? November 27th, as I’ve been told, or in the first ten days of December, or even – I really hope not – January 1st?” he began.

“The difference in dates for the announcement of his newly introduced role is by no means insignificant, because the January transfer window becomes a crucial turning point for Milan’s fortunes, both today and in the future.

“The sooner the Head of Football sits down at Casa Milan, the better he can weave his web to strengthen the team in the winter transfer window. This should have been the job of a year ago, but was not accomplished by a shortsighted management team that never understood the difference between costs and investments.

Industry observers note that “It’s also a shame that Igli Tare is a person who respects roles and is attentive to internal balances. He had to, and this is his great regret, bypass those who managed Milan, to speak with Gerry Cardinale and explain the importance of the arrival of a striker and a defender, who would have allowed them to be in the Champions League today.

“I’m using a very bold paradox, one I’ve never admitted. If failing to qualify for the Champions League was the reason that pushed Gerry Cardinale to fire the key figures of the three worst and most disastrous years in Milan’s history, then, given the exciting future prospects, it would have been better to lose against Cagliari, which avoided prolonging the agony of our dear old AC Milan. A painful sacrifice that, I hope, will be repaid with success in the years to come.

“With a Cardinale who was too absent and distant, guilty, by his own admission, of having delegated the management of his club to unsuitable people, but who now becomes the protagonist of this fresh way of operating, reminiscent of the good old days.

“I obviously feel sorry for Tare and Allegri, who, despite having their responsibilities, were victims of a confusing, chaotic, and divisive situation, and through no fault of their own.

“Returning to Krosche, I hope he promptly finds his feet in this Milan adventure that awaits him. I continue to believe that a highly experienced and highly skilled Italian operative, to work alongside the German director, could and can be of help to him and Milan, given the obvious difficulties of integrating into a world that is completely different from the German one.

“Gerry Cardinale and his chief assistant, Massimo Calvelli, are convinced of the wisdom of their choice, after meeting several times with Markus Krosche. I think it’s crucial that he’s not only a skilled market operator, but also a valid on-field contact for Ruben Amorim.

“The Portuguese will then be able to discuss potential choices and decisions with his Head of Football. In short, it was a position in the organisational chart that was culpably neglected, with the results that were seen, until Gerry Cardinale himself imposed Igli Tare, who, in any case, did not have an easy job.

“I mentioned Massimo Calvelli, who, in the media, always appears to be somewhat out of the spotlight. Certainly not in operational terms, because, from what I know, he was the absolute protagonist and architect of transactions that brought approximately €825m into Milan’s coffers.

“He was certainly a skilled architect of the return of Adidas as a shirt sponsor, but also a key figure in the acquisition of Generali, which will give its name to the new stadium, this time with the collaboration, it is stated, of Paolo Scaroni.

“Therefore, he is a valuable executive who works behind the scenes, but with excellent results in terms of economic and financial aspects and also for the club’s image.”.

Due assenze pesantissime, perché si tratta di giocatori moderni e indispensabili per 'Lucho', anche perché accomunati dalla caratteristica fondamentale ricercata come il Sacro Graal nel calcio moderno: la capacità di saltare l'uomo, creare superiorità e inventare qualcosa quando gli spazi vengono a mancare. Non è soltanto una questione numerica, ma un problema tecnico per una squadra che ha costruito gran parte della propria identità sulla mobilità e sulla qualità del reparto offensivo. La tegola arriva a pochi giorni dalla sfida contro la Roma, appuntamento sul calendario tra due giorni, il 25 novembre al Parco dei Principi.

Luis Enrique, almeno sulla carta, ha comunque diverse possibilità. Il primo nome ça va sans dire è Ousmane Dembélé, Pallone d'Oro e giocatore capace di ricoprire più posizioni nel tridente. C'è poi Ferran Torres, arrivato in estate e già protagonista. Lo spagnolo garantisce duttilità, può agire da esterno e più vicino alla porta, pur avendo caratteristiche differenti rispetto a Kvaratskhelia e Doué. Attenzione anche a Maghnes Akliouche e Mika Godts, entrambi capaci di offrire soluzioni diverse sulle corsie offensive. Il primo può giocare tra le linee e partire largo, il secondo ha nell'uno contro uno e nella velocità le proprie armi migliori. Infine Senny Mayulu, che permette al tecnico di modificare anche l'assetto tattico, senza necessariamente sostituire un esterno con un altro. La quantità non manca, l'esperienza europea invece sì.

According to recent reports, non si tratta d'emergenza rossa e di rosa cortissima, il PSG ha un'infinita quantità di risorse. Però le cronache dicono che Luis Campos si stia già guardando attorno per capire e valutare occasioni e nomi da prendere e portare alla corte di Luis Enrique. Luis Diaz pare il più logico, esperienza e qualità fatta ai tempi del Liverpool, poi ci sono i giovani come Estevao e Gianluca Prestianni, ma cari come l'oro, e un nome in ascesa come Eli Junior Kroupi. Da capire cosa vorrà fare il Paris: cercare un sostituto immediatamente pronto per la Champions oppure continuare a investire sui giovani, in linea con il progetto tecnico di Luis Enrique. La filosofia del collettivo resta centrale, ma perdere contemporaneamente Kvaratskhelia e Doué significa rinunciare a una quantità enorme di talento e imprevedibilità. Anche a Parigi i soldi non possono comprare tutto.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sources indicate that si torna nuovamente a parlare di Manolo Portanova e non per la sua carriera calcistica.
  • Sources indicate that portanova, figlio dell'ex difensore di Bologna e Siena Daniele, è accusato di fatti risalenti alla notte tra il 30 e il 31 maggio 2021.
  • L'identità della studentessa è rimasta riservata e il suo nome non è mai stato reso pubblico.

Sources indicate that si torna nuovamente a parlare di Manolo Portanova e non per la sua carriera calcistica. Il centrocampista della Reggiana, capitano e titolare in Serie C agli ordini di Attilio Tesser, ha indossato ieri la fascia rossa al braccio, simbolo della lotta alla violenza sulle donne, in occasione della sfida contro il Forlì. Una scelta che ha riacceso le polemiche, perché su di lui pende una condanna a sei anni per violenza sessuale di gruppo e lesioni.

Sources indicate that portanova, figlio dell'ex difensore di Bologna e Siena Daniele, è accusato di fatti risalenti alla notte tra il 30 e il 31 maggio 2021. Si trovava a Siena con lo zio Alessio Langella, con il fratello minore William, all'epoca minorenne, e con l'amico Alessandro Cappiello, quando incontrò una studentessa ventunenne. Secondo la ricostruzione, il gruppo avrebbe abusato di lei riprendendo la scena con i cellulari. Condannato in primo grado il 6 dicembre 2022, Portanova ha visto confermare la sentenza dalla Corte d'Appello di Firenze nel 2026. Attende ora il terzo e ultimo grado di giudizio e intanto continua a giocare da titolare con la Reggiana: quest'anno ha segnato sette gol in 15 partite.

L'identità della studentessa è rimasta riservata e il suo nome non è mai stato reso pubblico. Intervistata da Il Resto del Carlino, ha commentato così l'utilizzo della fascia: "Veder giocare con un simbolo simile chi è già stato dichiarato colpevole in primo e in secondo grado non è solo una contraddizione. È una ferita che torna a sanguinare, una beffa atroce, un male indicibile. Un dolore silenzioso e devastante che mi toglie il respiro. La mia esistenza da quel giorno si è fermata. Dopo ciò che mi è stato fatto, ho attraversato il buio del disturbo da stress post traumatico, gli attacchi di panico, la depressione e un'ansia che ha paralizzato ogni giorno della mia vita".

In a recent development, la Reggiana non ha cambiato il capitano. Il club ha sempre protetto Portanova, così come il tifo organizzato, anche se nel 2023, anno del suo arrivo in città, non sono mancate le disdette degli abbonamenti. Diverse associazioni contro la violenza sulle donne, su tutte Nondasola, si sono sempre schierate contro il suo impiego, chiedendo più volte un passo indietro al club. La vicepresidente Serena Corsi ha parlato di situazione "vergognosa" e ha ribadito: "Lui e la Reggiana sono impresentabili". Portanova si è sempre dichiarato innocente. Ad aprile, quando l'appello confermò la condanna, disse che tutto ciò che stava vivendo "era assurdo". E aggiunse: "Andrò avanti all'infinito", "non posso perdere la mia carriera. Sono un ragazzo buono, portare le prove della mia innocenza non basta. Non è stata fatta giustizia, continuerò a lottare fino alla fine".

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that overpowered and overrun, Arsenal were subjected to the sort of gruelling treatment they usually inflict on their opponents. Mikel Arteta’s side did not look anything like Premier League champions here, as Brighton and Hove Albion produced a stunning performance full of swarming energy and breathless bravery.

In a recent development, in the biggest test of their season so far, Arsenal fell woefully short of the standards they have set themselves over the past few campaigns. This sort of thing simply does not happen to Arteta’s side. Well, it did not happen. Not before this monstering on the south coast, where the Brighton fans were whipped into a frenzy by the brilliance of Fabian Hürzeler’s players.

Recent findings suggest that brighton were everything that Arsenal are expected to be: aggressive, inventive and dominant across the field. They even scored with a set-piece, as one of Arsenal’s great strengths became a sudden weakness. Everywhere Arteta looked, the foundational truths of his team were being shaken by a Brighton storm. It was their first defeat by a three-goal margin since May 2023, also against Brighton.

Remarkably, this is now the third consecutive season in which Brighton have beaten the reigning Premier League champions. They are rarely happier than when they are on the hunt against more illustrious opponents, working as a team to snap at heels and then attacking in numbers. They are known as the Seagulls, but they played more like a pack of bloodthirsty wolves. The ferocity of their off-the-ball work, especially in the first half, was extraordinary.

Sources indicate that not for a long time have Arsenal been as rattled as they were here. David Raya misplaced passes, Gabriel Magalhães lost duels and Bruno Guimarães chased the ball in vain. It was Brighton’s Pascal Gross, rather than Arsenal’s Martin Odegaard, who shaped the game in midfield. It was Brighton’s Charalampos Kostoulas, rather than Arsenal’s Kai Havertz, who offered incisive class in attack.

Sources indicate that gross and Kostoulas both struck from range in a one-sided first half, before Chema Andrés added the third after the break. At half-time, Arteta had sprinted down the tunnel towards the dressing room. Whatever messages he gave to his players, they either did not sink in or did not work. By the end, Arsenal were lucky the scoreline was not even more humiliating.

Arteta’s players had come through some tricky assignments in winning their first seven matches of this season, but this was their toughest test yet and they failed it badly. They did not handle the emotions of the occasion particularly well, either: in stoppage time, a frustrated Declan Rice kicked out at Malick Yalcouyé. He was perhaps fortunate to avoid a red card.

It was the first time that Rice and Guimarães had started alongside each other for Arsenal and it swiftly became clear that their £180m partnership will need some work. Arsenal would have hoped their experience in the Premier League would allow for an instant connection but, evidently, that is not the case. Guimarães was hooked after 60 minutes, but might easily have been removed at the break.

Recent findings suggest that both managers had a similar assessment of the match and how it was won: Brighton did the basics far better than Arsenal. “How we wanted to approach this game was getting into it through small wins,” Hürzeler noted. “Everyone speaks about a goal or chance as a win, but a small win can be the first throw-in, the first corner, win the first header, win the first tackle. These small things. If you win these small steps, and celebrate them as a win, then you can gain bigger and bigger wins.”.

It was typical of Brighton that one of their upcoming signings produced an excellent performance in midfield. Andrés, a 21-year-old Spaniard signed from Stuttgart at the end of the transfer window, looks to be the latest gem identified by their data-led recruitment model. No one inside the Amex Stadium was thinking about Carlos Baleba, sold to Manchester United, when Andrés made his tackles and won his headers.

Recent findings suggest that another fresh signing, centre-back Luka Vuskovic, was similarly impressive at the back. Signed for £46m from Tottenham Hotspur, Vuskovic looks more than capable of going to the top of the game.

According to recent reports, this was perhaps the first occasion this season in which Arsenal missed William Saliba, the injured centre-back who has been so fundamental to their success in recent years. The Frenchman can always be relied on to provide calmness and composure at the back, even under intense pressure. Without him, Arsenal were uncharacteristically jittery.

Recent findings suggest that “The amount of technical errors we did in our own half...” Arteta bemoaned. “We didn’t respect any principle of play that you have to get out of those man-to-man situations. That put us always on the back foot.”.

Gross, who at 35 is playing as well as ever, opened the scoring with a low shot from range after 31 minutes. Kostoulas then struck the second, from a similar distance, after some end-to-end action resulted in Arsenal’s midfield and defence melting away. The third was the most simple, as Andrés headed in at the back post from an inswinging corner.

It has been revealed that arsenal did have some chances, with Havertz missing the best of them, but there was never a sense that Brighton were vulnerable. The pressure on the home side was never sustained. For Arteta, who now has an extended international break in which to ruminate on this defeat, it all made for an unfamiliar and unexpected pain.

Mikel Arteta said his Arsenal players failed to “respect the game” as their perfect start to the season was ended in stunning style by a brilliant Brighton performance.

According to recent reports, arsenal’s capitulation on the south coast led to their first defeat of the campaign and Arteta admitted that Brighton had a different “edge” and “bite” throughout the match. The Arsenal manager also noted the 3-0 loss represented a “big lesson” for his players.

Industry observers note that “There are certain basics you need to accomplish in football, especially in the Premier League, that we were very far from,” Arteta said. “From the first throw-in you could sense it, it was so clear.

“It was a really disappointing result and performance. Brighton were another gear up from us. We were extremely poor technically and were not respecting the game.

“It is not going to take away what the team has done in the last six or seven weeks since coming back from the World Cup. What we have done and the way we have competed, and the amount of games we have won, has been remarkable. But this is a massive lesson for all of us to understand what it takes to win at this level.”.

Arteta added that his team did not “respect the principles of play” that were required against Brighton’s intense pressing, and also said his players were guilty of numerous technical errors.

In a recent development, “Credit to Brighton for what they have done because they have overcome us and they had another edge,” Arteta stated. “There are a lot of moments when the ball is 50/50 and it changes hands and most of the time it was for them.”.

Brighton are the Premier League’s top scorers this season with 16 goals in five matches so far, and this emphatic victory took them up to third place in the table.

According to recent reports, “It was a special win,” Fabian Hürzeler, the Brighton head coach, said. “Not only because we played the best team in England but because of the performance.
